orderingNote: Dictionary headwords: roots (kain) and the derived verbs Wiktionary lists as lemmas (kumain, kainin). Ordered by a blend of subtitle and web frequency, with inflected forms mapped to their headword; names, vulgar words and phrases removed. Ranks 5,001 and beyond are the next-best headwords by a blend of subtitle, web (FineWeb-2) and wordfreq counts; every one must be used in the web corpus or attested by three independent text families, and carry an ordinary English gloss (slang, archaic, dialectal, vulgar and form-of senses removed).

sentences.translation: That hut's floor is made of bamboo.

sentences.text: Gawa sa kawayan ang bahay nila sa probinsya.
sentences.translation: Their house in the province is made of bamboo.

sentences.text: Malaki ang gugol namin sa kuryente ngayong buwan.
sentences.translation: Our spending on electricity is big this month.

sentences.text: Magkano ang gugol mo sa pamasahe araw-araw?
sentences.translation: How much do you spend on fare every day?

cards.gloss: to violate; to break (a law, rule); to disobey

sentences.text: Iyan ay labag sa batas.
sentences.translation: That's against the law.

sentences.text: Huwag kang lumabag sa mga patakaran ng paaralan.
sentences.translation: Don't break the rules of the school.

sentences.text: Mahilig siyang gumawa ng tsismis, kaya marami siyang kalaban.
sentences.translation: He likes to gossip, therefore he has a lot of enemies.

sentences.text: Walang maniniwala sa tsismis na iyon.
sentences.translation: Nobody will believe that rumor.

sentences.text: Natatandaan kong nagsuot siya ng luntiang sombrero.
sentences.translation: I remember that she wore a green hat.

sentences.text: Bagay sa iyo ang luntian.
sentences.translation: Green suits you.

cards.gloss: to graduate; to finish; to end

sentences.text: Tapos na ba kayong mag-empake para sa biyahe ninyo?
sentences.translation: Have you finished packing for your trip?

sentences.text: Tapos na ba tayo?
sentences.translation: Are we finished?

sentences.text: Inumin ang katas na ito.
sentences.translation: Drink this juice.

sentences.text: Hindi pa ako tapos sa iyo.
sentences.translation: I'm not through with you yet.

sentences.text: Suportado ako ng pamilya ko sa pag-aaral.
sentences.translation: My family supports me in my studies.

sentences.text: Suportado ba ng kompanya ang proyektong ito?
sentences.translation: Does the company back this project?

sentences.text: Humingi siya ng tulong pinansiyal sa kapatid niya.
sentences.translation: He asked his sibling for financial help.

sentences.text: May problemang pinansiyal ba kayo ngayon?
sentences.translation: Do you have a financial problem right now?

cards.gloss: instructions; message or order left with someone

sentences.text: Bilang premyo nakatanggap siya ng gintong relo.
sentences.translation: He received a golden watch as a prize.

sentences.text: Nagtrabaho ako dati bilang weyter sa isang sosyal na kainan.
sentences.translation: I used to work as a waiter in a fancy restaurant.

sentences.text: Hindi na, salamat. Busog na ako.
sentences.translation: No, thank you. I'm so full.

sentences.text: Tama na ako; busog na ako.
sentences.translation: I've had enough; I'm full.

sentences.text: Dalawang tao ang nagsasabing nakarinig sila ng isang putok.
sentences.translation: Two people say they heard a gunshot.

sentences.text: Hindi ako sigurado kung ano iyon, ngunit parang putok ng baril.
sentences.translation: I'm not sure what it was, but it sounded like a gunshot.

cards.gloss: partner in an enterprise; helper in some effort

sentences.text: Katuwang ko ang asawa ko sa pag-aalaga ng mga bata.
sentences.translation: My spouse is my partner in taking care of the kids.

sentences.text: Naghahanap kami ng katuwang sa tindahan.
sentences.translation: We are looking for a helper in the store.

sentences.text: May bagong syota si Ben.
sentences.translation: Ben has a new girlfriend.

sentences.text: Hindi ko pa ipinakikilala ang syota ko sa nanay ko.
sentences.translation: I haven't introduced my boyfriend to my mother yet.

cards.gloss: based on (usually salig sa); dependent on

sentences.text: Salig sa totoong pangyayari ang pelikulang ito.
sentences.translation: This movie is based on a true event.

sentences.text: Ang bayad ay salig sa dami ng oras ng trabaho.
sentences.translation: The pay depends on the number of hours worked.

sentences.text: Maghugas gamit ang mainit at may sabon na tubig.
sentences.translation: Wash with hot, soapy water.

sentences.text: Maghugas ka ng kamay bago humawak ng pagkain.
sentences.translation: Wash your hands before you handle the food.

sentences.text: Ilang mangkok ng kanin ang kinain mo?
sentences.translation: How many bowls of rice did you eat?

sentences.text: Umiinom ang mga pusa ng gatas sa isang mangkok.
sentences.translation: The cats are drinking milk from a bowl.

sentences.text: Itinatanggi mo ba iyon?
sentences.translation: Do you deny that?

sentences.text: Nagulat ako sa pagtanggi niya sa alok namin.
sentences.translation: I was surprised by his refusal of our offer.

sentences.translation: Hand me the glue and the scissors in that box, please.

sentences.text: Gagamitin ko ang gunting na iyan sa paggupit ng dilaw na papel.
sentences.translation: I will use that pair of scissors to cut the yellow paper.

sentences.text: Kapag tama ka, tama ka.
sentences.translation: When you're right, you're right.

sentences.text: Masama ang pakiramdam ko kapag gumigising ako sa umaga.
sentences.translation: I feel sick when I get up in the morning.

sentences.text: Gumamit si Tatay ng kadena para itali ang bisikleta.
sentences.translation: Dad used a chain to lock up the bicycle.

sentences.text: Naputol ang kadena ng bisikleta ko kanina.
sentences.translation: The chain of my bicycle broke earlier.

sentences.text: Punit na ang pantalon ko sa tuhod.
sentences.translation: My pants are already torn at the knee.

sentences.text: Bakit punit ang pahina ng libro mo?
sentences.translation: Why is the page of your book torn?

sentences.text: Naalala kong ang Venecia ay parang laberintong puno ng mga antigong eskinita at kanal.
sentences.translation: I remember that Venice was like a labyrinth full of old alleyways and canals.

sentences.text: Umaapaw ang tubig sa kanal pagkatapos ng ulan.
sentences.translation: The water in the ditch overflows after the rain.

cards.gloss: to change clothes; to get dressed

sentences.text: Mayroon kang limang minuto para makapagbihis at bumaba.
sentences.translation: You have five minutes to get dressed and come downstairs.

sentences.text: Magbihis ka na at aalis na tayo.
sentences.translation: Get dressed now, because we are leaving.

sentences.text: Gaano kalayo mula dito papuntang susunod na baryo?
sentences.translation: How far is it from here to the next village?

sentences.text: Gusto kong magbalik sa baryo mo.
sentences.translation: I wanted to return to your village.

sentences.text: Matabang ang sabaw dahil walang asin.
sentences.translation: The soup is bland because there is no salt.

sentences.text: Matabang ba ang sopas, o kulang lang sa asin?
sentences.translation: Is the soup bland, or is it just short on salt?

sentences.translation: I will join the singing competition.

sentences.text: Kailan ang kompetisyon sa paaralan ninyo?
sentences.translation: When is the competition at your school?

sentences.translation: Where you pitch your tent is up to you.

sentences.text: Kausapin natin ang tagapamahala ng tindahan.
sentences.translation: Let's talk to the manager of the store.

sentences.translation: Conceited people think they are superior to others.

sentences.text: Nakakainis ang yabang ng kapitbahay namin.
sentences.translation: Our neighbor's bragging is annoying.

sentences.text: Pustahan, uulan mamaya.
sentences.translation: I bet it will rain later.

sentences.text: Ayokong sumali sa pustahan ninyo.
sentences.translation: I don't want to join your bet.

cards.gloss: being dragged into something; involvement; sharing in another's trouble

sentences.translation: The whole class got dragged into the teacher's punishment.

sentences.text: Pasensya na, damay ka pa sa gulo namin.
sentences.translation: Sorry, you got dragged into our mess too.

sentences.translation: I can't sleep because of nervousness.

sentences.translation: Take a deep breath so your nerves go away.

sentences.text: Dapat lahat bumoto.
sentences.translation: Everybody should vote.

sentences.text: Gusto naming bumoto.
sentences.translation: We want to vote.

sentences.text: Ayoko nang makarinig ng sermon ngayong umaga.
sentences.translation: I don't want to hear another lecture this morning.

sentences.translation: The bills keep piling up.

sentences.translation: I saw some ducks on the pond in the park near the library.

sentences.text: Huwag kang bumaba ng tren hanggang huminto ito.
sentences.translation: Don't get off the train till it stops.

sentences.text: Sa susunod na hinto, bababa na ako.
sentences.translation: At the next stop, I will get off.

sentences.translation: He went fishing using a spear.

sentences.text: Saan mo ginagamit ang mahabang sibat na iyan?
sentences.translation: Where do you use that long spear?

sentences.text: Nag-iba ang aming paraan sa buhay nang ipinakilala ang sibilisasyong taga-Europa.
sentences.translation: Our mode of life has changed since the introduction of European civilization.

sentences.text: Maraming sinaunang sibilisasyon ang nag-aral ng mga bituin.
sentences.translation: Many ancient civilizations studied the stars.

sentences.text: Unti-unting lumiliit ang populasyon ng bansang ito.
sentences.translation: The population of this country is gradually decreasing.

sentences.text: Ang liit ng kuwarto, hindi ba?
sentences.translation: It's a small room, isn't it?

sentences.translation: Afterwards, we went to Bethlehem to see the statues.

sentences.text: May malaking rebulto sa gitna ng plasa.
sentences.translation: There is a big statue in the middle of the plaza.

sentences.text: Mukhang malalaglag ka sa hagdan.
sentences.translation: It looks like you're going to fall off the ladder.

sentences.text: Laglag ako sa pagsusulit kaya malungkot ako.
sentences.translation: I failed the exam, so I am sad.

cards.gloss: idler; loafer; person who hangs around

sentences.text: Maraming tambay sa kanto tuwing gabi.
sentences.translation: There are many loafers at the corner every night.

sentences.text: Huwag kang maging tambay, maghanap ka ng trabaho.
sentences.translation: Don't be an idler, go look for a job.

sentences.translation: Do you have an alternative to this plan?

sentences.translation: The tail feathers and wings are gray.

sentences.translation: Our cat's fur is soft.

sentences.translation: Why are you following me, are you a spy?

sentences.translation: The rain has soaked through my clothes.

sentences.translation: Where can one buy books?

sentences.translation: How much is the fine if the payment is late?

sentences.translation: What level are you at in this game now?

sentences.translation: Where is the herd of goats?

sentences.translation: It hardly ever rains here.

sentences.text: Umulan buong araw kahapon.
sentences.translation: It rained all day yesterday.

sentences.translation: Grandma and Grandpa's new house is spacious.

sentences.translation: To Buddhists, anger and hate are defilements.

sentences.translation: She's the same height as me.

sentences.translation: We mended some broken chairs.

sentences.translation: Are you done with the laundry?

sentences.translation: Grandma needs support when walking.

sentences.translation: She learned English like that.

sentences.translation: We drive on the left side of the road.

sentences.translation: I'm driving a car.

sentences.translation: The governor set the prisoners free.

sentences.translation: The family visited the prisoner every Sunday.

cards.gloss: to run (a machine, business); to make something run (object focus)

sentences.translation: She cannot work this machine.

sentences.text: Mahirap simulang patakbuhin ang makina sa malalamig na umaga.

sentences.translation: I don't want to get dragged into your fight.

sentences.translation: Let's greet our visitors.

sentences.translation: They greeted us in French.

sentences.translation: We must've taken the wrong road.

sentences.translation: A trucker nearly froze to death on the road.

sentences.text: Malamig sa taglamig, kaya natin binubuksan ang kalan.
sentences.translation: In the winter it's cold, so we turn on the stove.

cards.gloss: footprint; footstep; act of stepping on something

sentences.translation: Keep off the grass!

sentences.text: Tumapak ka sa timbangan.
sentences.translation: Stand on the scales.

sentences.translation: There is a singing contest at school tomorrow.

sentences.translation: Are you joining the cooking competition?

sentences.translation: I want to study philosophy in college.

sentences.text: Ano ang pilosopiya mo sa buhay?
sentences.translation: What is your philosophy in life?

sentences.translation: I almost drowned.

sentences.text: Nalunod silang lahat.
sentences.translation: They all drowned.

sentences.translation: Ben felt jealous when his new sibling arrived.

sentences.text: Bakit ka nagseselos sa kaibigan ko?
sentences.translation: Why are you jealous of my friend?

cards.gloss: supposedly; allegedly; so they say (quotative particle)

sentences.text: Pagod kuno siya kaya hindi sumama.
sentences.translation: He's supposedly tired, so he didn't come along.

sentences.text: Masarap kuno ang pagkain sa bagong restawran.
sentences.translation: They say the food at the new restaurant is good.

sentences.text: Nakatali ang aso sa mahabang tanikala.
sentences.translation: The dog is tied to a long chain.

sentences.text: Kinandado ni Tatay ang gate gamit ang tanikala.
sentences.translation: Dad locked the gate with a chain.

sentences.text: Nanood kami ng pelikulang may sampal sa huling eksena.
sentences.translation: We watched a movie with a slap in the last scene.

sentences.text: Bakit mo siya binigyan ng sampal?
sentences.translation: Why did you give him a slap?

cards.gloss: to peek; to take a peek (actor focus)

sentences.translation: Ben peeked out the window to look at the rain.

sentences.text: Huwag kang sumilip sa kuwarto ko!
sentences.translation: Don't peek into my room!

sentences.translation: We tried to make out the letters written on the wall.

sentences.text: Alam mo ba ang letra ng kantang ito?
sentences.translation: Do you know the lyrics of this song?

sentences.translation: What will you wear to the occasion tomorrow?

sentences.translation: Tom arrived half an hour early.

sentences.translation: I like pink grapefruit.

sentences.translation: I wrote Grandma's biography for class.

sentences.translation: This writer's biography is interesting.

sentences.translation: I woke up in the middle of the night because of a nightmare.

sentences.text: Nagkaroon siya ng bangungot pagkatapos manood ng nakakatakot na pelikula.
sentences.translation: He had a nightmare after watching a scary movie.

sentences.text: Maselan sa pagkain ang kapatid ko.
sentences.translation: My sibling is fussy about food.

sentences.translation: A baby's skin is delicate, so handle it gently.

sentences.translation: We have a household helper who helps with the housework.

sentences.translation: What time is your household helper arriving?

sentences.translation: He has no less than five English books.

sentences.translation: It's been five years since I last saw you.

sentences.translation: He became even more anxious because of the news.

sentences.translation: Mom is anxious while waiting for Ate's call.

sentences.translation: The people answered amen after the prayer.

sentences.translation: The family said amen together.

sentences.text: Nasaktan ba kita?
sentences.translation: Did I hurt you?

sentences.text: Dahil may sakit siya, napuwersa siyang ideley ang miting.

sentences.text: Ang lakas ng radyo. Pakihinaan.
sentences.translation: The radio is too loud. Please turn the volume down.

sentences.text: May tsansa bang gagaling siya?
sentences.translation: Is there any chance that he'll recover?

sentences.text: Bigyan mo naman ako ng tsansa.
sentences.translation: Please give me a chance.

sentences.text: Masaya ang unang akto ng dula.
sentences.translation: The first act of the play is fun.

sentences.text: Nahuli ko ang pusa sa akto habang kumakain ng isda.
sentences.translation: I caught the cat in the act of eating fish.

sentences.text: Pinahanga ng lalaki ang babae sa pamamagitan ng salamangka.
sentences.translation: The man impressed the woman with magic tricks.

sentences.text: Naniniwala ka ba talaga sa salamangka?
sentences.translation: Do you really believe in magic?

sentences.text: Popular siya sa kanyang mga kasamahan.
sentences.translation: He is popular among his colleagues.

sentences.text: Popular ang tennis sa mga estudyante.
sentences.translation: Tennis is very popular amongst students.

sentences.text: Puno na ang tangke ng tubig namin.
sentences.translation: Our water tank is already full.

sentences.text: Puwede bang punuin ang tangke ng gasolina?
sentences.translation: Can you fill up the gas tank?

sentences.text: Sana nasa pangkat natin siya.
sentences.translation: I wish he were on our team.

sentences.text: Aling pangkat ang nakalalamang?
sentences.translation: Which team is likely to win?

sentences.text: Narinig ko ang taghoy ng batang nawalan ng laruan.
sentences.translation: I heard the wail of the child who lost his toy.

sentences.text: May kaliskis ang isda.
sentences.translation: Fish have scales.

sentences.text: Tanggalin mo ang kaliskis bago iprito ang isda.
sentences.translation: Remove the scales before frying the fish.

sentences.text: Naniniwala akong hindi ito makatotohanan.
sentences.translation: I believe it's not realistic.

sentences.text: Narinig ko ang malakas na katok sa pinto.
sentences.translation: I heard a loud knock on the door.

sentences.text: Sino ang kumakatok sa bintana ko?
sentences.translation: Who is knocking at my window?

sentences.text: Nasaan na ang jowa mo?
sentences.translation: Where is your partner now?

sentences.text: May jowa na ang kapatid ko.
sentences.translation: My sibling has a boyfriend or girlfriend now.

sentences.text: Huwag kang manamantala sa mahihina.
sentences.translation: Don't take advantage of the weak.

sentences.text: Nanamantala ang ilang tindero noong bagyo at itinaas ang presyo.
sentences.translation: Some vendors took advantage during the storm and raised their prices.

sentences.text: Bumili ako ng dalawang daang gramo ng keso.
sentences.translation: I bought two hundred grams of cheese.

sentences.text: Ilang gramo ng asukal ang kailangan sa resipe na ito?
sentences.translation: How many grams of sugar does this recipe need?

sentences.text: Kalapastangan ang pagtatapon ng basura sa ilog natin.
sentences.translation: Dumping trash in our river is an outrage.

sentences.text: Hindi ko matanggap ang ganitong kalapastangan sa mga matatanda.
sentences.translation: I can't accept this kind of disrespect toward the elderly.

sentences.text: Isang inmigrante ang bago naming kapitbahay.
sentences.translation: Our new neighbor is an immigrant.

sentences.text: Maraming inmigrante ang naghahanap ng trabaho dito.
sentences.translation: Many immigrants are looking for work here.

sentences.text: Gumagawa kami ng imbentaryo sa tindahan tuwing katapusan ng buwan.
sentences.translation: We do an inventory at the store at the end of every month.

sentences.text: Nasaan ang imbentaryo ng mga gamot?
sentences.translation: Where is the inventory of the medicines?

cards.gloss: to be killed; to manage to kill

sentences.text: Patay na siya nang sampung taon na.
sentences.translation: He has been dead for ten years.

sentences.text: Pinatay mo ba ang lalaking iyan? Oo o hindi?
sentences.translation: Did you kill that man? Yes or no?

sentences.text: Uto lang pala ang pangako niya sa akin.
sentences.translation: His promise to me was just a trick, it turns out.

sentences.text: Huwag kang maniwala, uto lang iyan.
sentences.translation: Don't believe it, that's just a con.

cards.gloss: about; concerning; regarding (usually with sa or kay)

sentences.text: Mag-usap tayo hinggil sa gastos natin.
sentences.translation: Let's talk about our expenses.

sentences.text: May tanong po ako hinggil sa aralin natin.
sentences.translation: I have a question about our lesson.

sentences.text: Nagtagumpay siya sa harap ng maraming pagsusubok.
sentences.translation: He succeeded in the face of many trials.

sentences.text: Sumubok siya, at nagawa niya.
sentences.translation: He tried, and he did it.

cards.gloss: to heat up; to warm up (object focus)

sentences.text: Umiinit nang umiinit na.
sentences.translation: It is getting warmer and warmer.

sentences.text: Ang init dito.
sentences.translation: It's hot in here.

sentences.text: Tutol kami sa dahas sa loob ng paaralan.
sentences.translation: We are against violence inside schools.

sentences.text: Hindi dahas ang sagot sa problema.
sentences.translation: Violence is not the answer to a problem.

sentences.text: Ang Amerika ay lugar ng oportunidad.
sentences.translation: America is the land of opportunity.

sentences.text: Magandang oportunidad ito para matuto ng bagong wika.
sentences.translation: This is a good opportunity to learn a new language.

sentences.text: Masarap ang sopas na may kabute.
sentences.translation: Soup with mushrooms is delicious.

sentences.text: Saan ka bumili ng sariwang kabute?
sentences.translation: Where did you buy the fresh mushrooms?

sentences.text: Naglinis ang buong komunidad namin kahapon.
sentences.translation: Our whole community cleaned up yesterday.

sentences.text: Anong tulong ang kailangan ng inyong komunidad?
sentences.translation: What help does your community need?

sentences.text: Ituro mo sa akin ang daan papuntang eskuwela.
sentences.translation: Show me the way to school.

sentences.text: Pumapasok sa eskwela ang bata kahit na gusto niyang matulog.
sentences.translation: The child goes to school even though he or she wants to sleep.

sentences.text: Ano ang sasabihin mo para kumbinsihin siyang bumili ng isa?
sentences.translation: What would you say to convince him to buy one?

sentences.text: Kukumbinsihin ko si Nanay na sumama sa atin.
sentences.translation: I will convince Mom to come along with us.

sentences.text: Aa, naiintindihan ko na ngayon.
sentences.translation: Ah, now I understand.

sentences.text: Aa, ikaw pala iyan!
sentences.translation: Oh, it's you!

sentences.text: Sa isang sulyap, alam kong masaya siya.
sentences.translation: At a single glance, I knew she was happy.

sentences.text: Sumulyap siya sa orasan.
sentences.translation: He glanced at the clock.

cards.gloss: patch (for mending); dental filling; makeshift repair

sentences.text: May tambal na ang ngipin ko.
sentences.translation: My tooth already has a filling.

sentences.text: Lagyan natin ng tambal ang butas ng gulong.
sentences.translation: Let's put a patch on the hole in the tire.

sentences.text: Humingi ako ng permiso kay Tatay.
sentences.translation: I asked Dad for permission.

sentences.text: Kailangan mo ba ng permiso para pumasok dito?
sentences.translation: Do you need a permit to enter here?

cards.gloss: to wash clothes; to launder (locative focus)

sentences.text: Labhan mo ang damit sa tubig na may sabon at matatanggal ang mga mantsa.
sentences.translation: Wash the clothes in soapy water and the stains will come out.

sentences.text: Labhan mo ang mga damit bago magtanghali.
sentences.translation: Wash the clothes before noon.

sentences.text: Madalas ka bang magdasal?
sentences.translation: Do you often pray?

sentences.text: Nagdasal na ako.
sentences.translation: I already prayed.

cards.gloss: to take someone somewhere; to see off; to deliver

sentences.text: Pwede kitang ihatid kung gusto mo.
sentences.translation: I can take you there if you want.

sentences.text: Ihatid mo naman siya sa labas.
sentences.translation: Please see him or her out.

sentences.text: Nalubog ang buong nayon sa dilubyo.
sentences.translation: The whole village was submerged in the great flood.

sentences.text: Natatakot ang mga tao na may darating na dilubyo.
sentences.translation: People are afraid that a great flood is coming.

sentences.text: Mahiyain akong bata.
sentences.translation: I am a shy child.

sentences.text: Mahiyain siya noong high school pa lang siya.
sentences.translation: She was shy in her high school days.

cards.gloss: cut; style of cut (of cloth, clothing)

sentences.text: Gusto ko ang tabas ng damit mo.
sentences.translation: I like the cut of your dress.

sentences.text: Anong tabas ng palda ang gusto mo?
sentences.translation: What style of skirt do you want?

sentences.text: Napakabata mo pa para magpakasal.
sentences.translation: You're too young to get married.

sentences.text: Ikakasal pa kaya ako?
sentences.translation: I wonder if I'll ever get married.

sentences.text: Kailangan kong gumamit ng palikuran.
sentences.translation: I have to go to the toilet.

sentences.text: Pumunta kami sa likuran ng kotse at saka tumulak.
sentences.translation: We got behind the car and pushed.

sentences.text: Araw-araw akong sumasakay ng bus papuntang eskuwela.
sentences.translation: I take the bus to school every day.

sentences.text: Mahuhuli ka na sa eskwela.
sentences.translation: You're going to be late for school.

sentences.text: Nakasando lang si Tatay sa bahay.
sentences.translation: Dad is just wearing an undershirt at home.

sentences.text: Bumili ako ng puting sando sa palengke.
sentences.translation: I bought a white sleeveless shirt at the market.

sentences.text: Nakita sa radar ang paparating na bagyo.
sentences.translation: The approaching storm was seen on the radar.

sentences.text: Gumagamit ng radar ang mga eroplano.
sentences.translation: Airplanes use radar.

sentences.text: Masaklap ang nangyari sa kanya kahapon.
sentences.translation: What happened to him yesterday was unfortunate.

sentences.text: Masaklap ba ang naging resulta ng pagsusulit mo?
sentences.translation: Did your exam turn out badly?

sentences.text: Malakas ang pagnanasa niyang makauwi sa probinsya.
sentences.translation: He has a strong longing to go home to the province.

sentences.text: May pagnanasa akong maglakbay sa buong mundo.
sentences.translation: I have a desire to travel around the world.

sentences.text: Naghanda kami para sa hagupit ng bagyo.
sentences.translation: We prepared for the fury of the storm.

sentences.text: Sinalanta ng hagupit ng bagyo ang baybayin.
sentences.translation: The storm's lashing devastated the coast.

sentences.text: Anong kurso ang kinukuha mo sa kolehiyo?
sentences.translation: What course are you taking in college?

sentences.text: Natapos ni Ate ang kurso niya noong nakaraang taon.
sentences.translation: My older sister finished her degree last year.

cards.gloss: to pour liquid on someone or something (locative focus)

sentences.text: Nahimatay ang batang lalaki, pero nahimasmasan siya nang binuhusan namin siya ng tubig.
sentences.translation: The boy fainted, but he came to when we poured water on him.

sentences.text: Buhusan mo ng tubig ang halaman.
sentences.translation: Pour water on the plant.

sentences.text: Ano ang kaugnayan mo kay Ben?
sentences.translation: What is your relation to Ben?

sentences.text: Walang kaugnayan ang sinabi mo sa paksa natin.
sentences.translation: What you said has no connection to our topic.

sentences.text: May binulong siya sa kanya.
sentences.translation: He whispered something to her.

sentences.text: Anong binulong niya sa iyo?
sentences.translation: What did she whisper to you?

sentences.text: Magaling maghapon si Ginoong Brown.
sentences.translation: Mr Brown speaks Japanese very well.

sentences.text: Si Ginoong Jackson ay ang pinakamalalang guro.
sentences.translation: Mr. Jackson is the worst teacher.

sentences.text: Malamig sa bulubundukin tuwing umaga.
sentences.translation: It is cold in the mountain range every morning.

sentences.text: Naglakbay kami sa magandang bulubundukin sa hilaga.
sentences.translation: We traveled to the beautiful mountain region in the north.

cards.gloss: rag; cleaning cloth; (locative focus) to read to or from

sentences.text: Nabasa mo ba lahat?
sentences.translation: Did you read it at all?

sentences.text: Nakakapagbasa ako ng Ingles.
sentences.translation: I am able to read English.

sentences.text: Edukado ang mga magulang niya.
sentences.translation: His parents are educated.

sentences.text: Gusto ni Nanay na maging edukado ang mga anak niya.
sentences.translation: Mom wants her children to be educated.

sentences.text: Mataas ang renta ng apartment namin.
sentences.translation: The rent on our apartment is high.

sentences.text: Magkano ang renta mo kada buwan?
sentences.translation: How much is your rent each month?

cards.gloss: to play (music or an instrument) (object focus); tune

sentences.text: Anong awit ang tinutugtog niya?
sentences.translation: What song is she playing?

sentences.text: Naiinis si Fred kapag nakakarinig siya ng maingay na tugtog.
sentences.translation: When Fred hears loud music, he gets annoyed.

sentences.text: Nagdagdag si Nanay ng kaunting brandi sa cake.
sentences.translation: Mom added a little brandy to the cake.

sentences.text: Para saan ang brandi sa resipe na ito?
sentences.translation: What is the brandy for in this recipe?

sentences.text: Nakatanggap si Lolo ng pensiyon ngayong buwan.
sentences.translation: Grandpa received his pension this month.

sentences.text: Mura ang pensiyon na tinuluyan namin sa Baguio.
sentences.translation: The guesthouse we stayed at in Baguio was cheap.

sentences.text: Patag ang daan papunta sa bayan.
sentences.translation: The road to town is flat.

sentences.text: Humanap tayo ng patag na lugar para sa tolda.
sentences.translation: Let's find a level place for the tent.

sentences.text: Hindi mawala ang bagabag ko tungkol sa pagsusulit.
sentences.translation: My worry about the exam won't go away.

sentences.text: Bakit may bakas ng bagabag sa mukha mo?
sentences.translation: Why is there a trace of worry on your face?

sentences.text: Matagal ang giling ng mais kung kamay lang ang gamit.
sentences.translation: Grinding corn takes a long time if you only use your hands.

sentences.text: Magkano ang bayad sa giling ng palay?
sentences.translation: How much is the fee for milling rice?

sentences.text: Nakakainis ang kayabangan niya.
sentences.translation: His arrogance is annoying.

sentences.text: Huwag mong ipakita ang kayabangan mo sa harap ng bisita.
sentences.translation: Don't show off your arrogance in front of the guests.

sentences.text: Noon, malakas akong manigarilyo, pero tumigil ako.
sentences.translation: I used to smoke a lot, but now I've quit.

sentences.text: May posporo ka ba? Paumanhin pero hindi ako naninigarilyo.
sentences.translation: Do you have a match? I'm sorry, but I don't smoke.

sentences.text: Mamimiss ko ang luto mo.
sentences.translation: I'll miss your cooking.

sentences.text: Magluluto ang tatay ko ng masarap na pagkain bukas ng umaga.
sentences.translation: My father will cook a delicious meal tomorrow morning.

sentences.text: Umarteng masaya si Tomas, pero sa kalaliman niya, malungkot siya.
sentences.translation: Tom acted happy, but deep inside he was sad.

sentences.text: Sinukat namin ang kalaliman ng ilog.
sentences.translation: We measured the depth of the river.

sentences.text: Kailangan ng bata ng proteksyon laban sa init ng araw.
sentences.translation: A child needs protection from the heat of the sun.

sentences.text: Nagsuot siya ng helmet para sa proteksyon.
sentences.translation: He wore a helmet for protection.

sentences.text: Magaling siya sa larangan ng palakasan.
sentences.translation: She is good in the field of sports.

sentences.text: Anong larangan ang gusto mong pasukin?
sentences.translation: What field do you want to go into?

sentences.text: Kung babatayin sa pisikal na anyo, ang dalawang lalaki ay magkaibang-magkaiba.
sentences.translation: Physically, the two men were very different.

sentences.text: Ano ang batayan mo sa sinabi mong iyon?
sentences.translation: What is your basis for what you said?

sentences.text: Sinusuway po ninyo ang mga patakaran.
sentences.translation: You're breaking the rules.

sentences.text: Ang pagsuway sa magulang ay hindi mabuti.
sentences.translation: Disobeying one's parents is not good.

sentences.text: Sardinas at kanin ang almusal namin ngayon.
sentences.translation: We're having sardines and rice for breakfast today.

sentences.text: Bumili ka ng dalawang lata ng sardinas sa tindahan.
sentences.translation: Buy two cans of sardines at the store.

sentences.text: Naglalambing ang bata sa kanyang nanay.
sentences.translation: The child is being affectionate with her mother.

sentences.text: Mahilig sa lambing ang pusa namin.
sentences.translation: Our cat loves affection.

sentences.text: Regular na estudyante ako sa paaralang ito.
sentences.translation: I am a regular student at this school.

sentences.text: Ano ang regular na oras ng klase ninyo?
sentences.translation: What is your usual class time?

sentences.text: Tradisyonal na damit ang suot ni Lola.
sentences.translation: Grandma is wearing traditional clothes.

sentences.text: Mas masarap ang tradisyonal na paraan ng pagluluto.
sentences.translation: The traditional way of cooking tastes better.

sentences.text: Isang malakas na hiyaw ang gumising sa akin.
sentences.translation: A loud shout woke me up.

sentences.text: Narinig mo ba ang hiyaw ng bata sa labas?
sentences.translation: Did you hear the child's yell outside?

sentences.text: May malaking estatwa sa gitna ng parke.
sentences.translation: There is a big statue in the middle of the park.

sentences.text: Gusto mo bang magpakuha ng litrato sa tabi ng estatwa?
sentences.translation: Do you want to have your picture taken next to the statue?

sentences.text: Walang kasalanan maliban sa katangahan.
sentences.translation: There is no sin except stupidity.

sentences.text: Ang pagkatanda ay hindi proteksiyon sa katangahan.
sentences.translation: Age is no protection against stupidity.

cards.gloss: to send someone home; to let someone go home (object focus)

sentences.text: Pinauwi ng guro ang batang may lagnat.
sentences.translation: The teacher sent the child with a fever home.

sentences.text: Pauwiin mo na ang mga bata, gabi na.
sentences.translation: Let the children go home now, it's already night.

sentences.text: Kuba na si Lolo dahil matanda na siya.
sentences.translation: Grandpa is hunched over because he is old now.

sentences.text: Huwag kang umupo nang nakakuba, masakit sa likod.
sentences.translation: Don't sit hunched over, it hurts your back.

cards.gloss: to make more beautiful; to improve (object focus)

sentences.text: Pagandahin natin ang hardin bago dumating ang bisita.
sentences.translation: Let's make the garden prettier before the guests arrive.

sentences.text: Pagandahin mo ang sulat mo para mabasa ng guro.
sentences.translation: Make your handwriting nicer so the teacher can read it.

sentences.text: Iba na ang kapanahunan ngayon kaysa noon.
sentences.translation: The times are different now than before.

sentences.text: Sa kapanahunan ni Lola, walang kuryente sa maraming bahay.
sentences.translation: In Grandma's era, many homes had no electricity.

sentences.text: Isang baso ng tubig, po.
sentences.translation: I'd like a glass of water, please.

sentences.text: Hindi. Ayaw niya ng tubig!
sentences.translation: No. He doesn't like water!

sentences.text: Tumutunog ang kampana nang alas-otso.
sentences.translation: That bell rings at eight.

sentences.text: Di pa kumalembang ang kampana.
sentences.translation: The bell has not rung yet.

sentences.text: Dapat magtiyaga ka.
sentences.translation: You have to be persistent.

sentences.text: Kailangan ng tiyaga sa pag-aaral ng bagong wika.
sentences.translation: You need perseverance to learn a new language.

cards.gloss: soaking (in liquid); (colloquial) staying long at something

sentences.text: Nasa babad pa ang mga damit.
sentences.translation: The clothes are still soaking.

sentences.text: Babad ka na naman sa telebisyon.
sentences.translation: You're glued to the TV again.

sentences.text: Kalaunan, nakulong din ang salbaheng lalaki.
sentences.translation: Eventually, the wicked man was jailed too.

sentences.text: Huwag kang maging salbahe sa kapatid mo.
sentences.translation: Don't be naughty to your sibling.

sentences.text: Bumoto ang senador para sa panukalang batas.
sentences.translation: The senator voted for the bill.

sentences.text: Ang bawat senador ay may anim na taong termino.
sentences.translation: Each senator has a six-year term.

sentences.text: Mapaminsala sa kalusugan ang sobrang asukal.
sentences.translation: Too much sugar is harmful to your health.

sentences.text: Mapaminsala ba sa halaman ang gamot na ito?
sentences.translation: Is this medicine harmful to plants?

sentences.text: May sorpresa ako para sa iyo ngayong kaarawan mo.
sentences.translation: I have a surprise for you on your birthday.

sentences.text: Nagulat siya sa sorpresa ng mga kaibigan niya.
sentences.translation: She was startled by her friends' surprise.

sentences.text: Namatay sa kanser ang kanyang lolo noong nakaraang taon.
sentences.translation: His grandfather died of cancer last year.

sentences.text: Mahalaga ang pagpapatingin sa doktor para maagapan ang kanser.
sentences.translation: Seeing a doctor is important to catch cancer early.

sentences.text: Sino ang may pakana?
sentences.translation: Who's behind the plot?

sentences.text: Nakatulog ang aking kanang kamay.
sentences.translation: My right hand has fallen asleep.

sentences.text: Masunurin ba ang aso mo?
sentences.translation: Is your dog obedient?

sentences.text: Masunurin na bata si Ana.
sentences.translation: Ana is an obedient child.

sentences.text: Nagsindi si Lola ng insenso sa bahay.
sentences.translation: Grandma lit incense at home.

sentences.text: Gusto mo ba ang amoy ng insenso?
sentences.translation: Do you like the smell of incense?

sentences.text: Porke umulan, hindi ka na papasok?
sentences.translation: Just because it rained, you're not going in anymore?

sentences.text: Porke bata siya, hindi ibig sabihin na hindi siya marunong.
sentences.translation: Just because he is a child doesn't mean he doesn't know how.

sentences.text: Nakakaantala ang pag-aalangan.
sentences.translation: Hesitating causes delay.

sentences.text: Alanganin akong sumagot kasi hindi ako sigurado.
sentences.translation: I'm hesitant to answer because I'm not sure.

sentences.text: Siya ang tagapagmana ng lupa ng pamilya.
sentences.translation: He is the heir to the family's land.

sentences.text: Sino ang magiging tagapagmana ng tindahan?
sentences.translation: Who will be the heir of the store?

cards.gloss: to try one's luck; to venture; to risk

sentences.text: Gusto niyang makipagsapalaran sa ibang bansa.
sentences.translation: He wants to try his luck abroad.

sentences.text: Nakipagsapalaran si Tatay sa Maynila noong bata pa siya.
sentences.translation: Dad tried his luck in Manila when he was young.

cards.gloss: message or instruction left with someone; something entrusted

sentences.text: Ito ang habilin ni Nanay bago siya umalis.
sentences.translation: This is Mom's instruction, left before she went away.

sentences.text: May iniwan bang habilin si Tatay para sa akin?
sentences.translation: Did Dad leave any message for me?

sentences.text: Gagawin ko iyan sa kondisyon na tutulungan mo ako.
sentences.translation: I will do it on the condition that you help me.

sentences.text: Maganda pa ang kondisyon ng lumang kotse namin.
sentences.translation: Our old car is still in good condition.

sentences.text: Kainin mo ang sopas mo nang walang ingay.
sentences.translation: Have your soup without making noise.

sentences.text: Paano ang lasa ng sopas?
sentences.translation: How does this soup taste?

sentences.text: Nanananghalian ako dito dalawa o tatlong beses sa isang linggo.
sentences.translation: I eat lunch here two or three times a week.

sentences.text: Gumagawa ako ng tanghalian bawat araw.
sentences.translation: I make lunch every day.

cards.gloss: to confess; to tell the truth frankly

sentences.text: Gusto kong magtapat sa iyo ng totoo.
sentences.translation: I want to tell you the truth.

sentences.text: Nagtapat siya sa guro na siya ang nakabasag ng bintana.
sentences.translation: He confessed to the teacher that he was the one who broke the window.

cards.gloss: naked from the waist down; bare

sentences.text: Malaki ang suweldo niya sa bagong trabaho.
sentences.translation: His salary at the new job is big.

sentences.text: Kailan ang suweldo natin ngayong buwan?
sentences.translation: When is our payday this month?

cards.gloss: to become smaller; to shrink; to decrease

sentences.text: Ang isdang ito ay may maraming maliliit na buto sa katawan.
sentences.translation: This fish has a lot of small bones in it.

sentences.text: Aling sapatos ang napakaliit?
sentences.translation: Which shoes are too small?

sentences.text: Naniniwala ang mga sinaunang tao sa maraming bathala.

sentences.text: Makinis ang balat ng sanggol.
sentences.translation: The baby's skin is smooth.

sentences.text: Makinis na ang kalsada pagkatapos nilang ayusin.
sentences.translation: The road is smooth now after they fixed it.

sentences.text: Bumili ako ng balut sa tabi ng kalsada.
sentences.translation: I bought balut by the roadside.

sentences.text: Gusto mo bang kumain ng balut?
sentences.translation: Do you want to eat balut?

sentences.text: Binasa mo ba ang dyaryo ngayon?
sentences.translation: Have you read today's paper?

sentences.text: Nagbabasa siya ng dyaryo kada umaga.
sentences.translation: He reads the newspaper every morning.

sentences.text: Nakikita po ng lahat ang pag-usad natin.
sentences.translation: Everyone can see the progress we made.

sentences.text: Umuusad po ang proyekto kagaya ng inaasahan.
sentences.translation: The project is progressing as expected.

sentences.text: Kasya ang limampung tao sa bus.
sentences.translation: This bus can hold fifty people.

sentences.text: Ito ang pinakamainit na tag-araw na naranasan natin sa loob ng limampung taon.
sentences.translation: This is the hottest summer we have had in fifty years.

sentences.text: Di parating wais ang mga dakilang tao.
sentences.translation: Great people are not always wise.

sentences.text: Parating na ang tren!
sentences.translation: The train is coming!

sentences.text: Puwede mo bang alisin ang bara sa printer?
sentences.translation: Can you unjam the printer?

sentences.text: May bara sa lababo kaya hindi umaagos ang tubig.
sentences.translation: There is a clog in the sink, so the water won't drain.

sentences.text: Lusot na ang pusa sa butas ng bakod.
sentences.translation: The cat has slipped through the hole in the fence.

sentences.text: Lusot ako sa pagsusulit kahit hindi ako masyadong nag-aral.
sentences.translation: I got through the exam even though I didn't study much.

cards.gloss: to oppress; to mistreat; to bully (object focus)

sentences.text: Inapi niya ako.
sentences.translation: He mistreated me.

sentences.text: Huwag mong apihin ang mga mahihina.
sentences.translation: Do not mistreat those who are weak.

sentences.text: Maraming dinastiya ang namuno sa Tsina noon.
sentences.translation: Many dynasties ruled China in the past.

sentences.text: Pinag-aralan namin ang isang dinastiya sa klase ng kasaysayan.
sentences.translation: We studied a dynasty in history class.

sentences.text: Abay ako sa kasal ng pinsan ko.
sentences.translation: I am a wedding attendant at my cousin's wedding.

sentences.text: Sino ang mga abay sa kasal ninyo?
sentences.translation: Who are the attendants at your wedding?

sentences.text: Pininturahan ni Tatay ang bakod namin.
sentences.translation: Father painted our fence.

sentences.text: Mataas ang bakod ng bahay nila.
sentences.translation: The fence around their house is tall.

sentences.text: Mali ang diskriminasyon sa kapwa.
sentences.translation: Discrimination against others is wrong.

sentences.text: Walang diskriminasyon sa paaralan namin.
sentences.translation: There is no discrimination at our school.

sentences.text: Nasa gabinete ang mga plato.
sentences.translation: The plates are in the cabinet.

sentences.text: Bumili kami ng bagong gabinete para sa kusina.
sentences.translation: We bought a new cabinet for the kitchen.

sentences.text: Noong araw, nagbibigay ng dote ang pamilya ng babae sa kasal.
sentences.translation: In the old days, the bride's family gave a dowry at the wedding.

sentences.text: Malaki raw ang dote ni Lola noong ikinasal siya.
sentences.translation: They say Grandmother's dowry was big when she got married.

sentences.text: Tumaas ang presyo ng petrolyo ngayong linggo.
sentences.translation: The price of petroleum went up this week.

sentences.text: Nakasakit kami ng mga tao.
sentences.translation: We harmed people.

sentences.text: Paano kung magkasakit ka?
sentences.translation: What if you get ill?

sentences.text: Umapela ang abogado ko.
sentences.translation: My lawyer appealed.

sentences.text: Nagsumite ang abogado ng apela sa korte.
sentences.translation: The lawyer submitted an appeal to the court.

sentences.text: Kailangan ko bang gamitin ang tinta sa pagsusulat?
sentences.translation: Do I have to write with ink?

sentences.text: Ang tinta ng pusit ay maaaring kainin samantala ang tinta ng bolpen ay hindi.
sentences.translation: Squid ink is edible whereas ballpen ink is not.

sentences.text: Bakit napakabango ng trapong hawak mo?
sentences.translation: Why does the rag in your hand smell so good?

sentences.text: Mabango ang niluluto ni Nanay.
sentences.translation: What Mother is cooking smells good.

sentences.text: Nag-aral ako bago naghapunan.
sentences.translation: I studied before supper.

sentences.text: Nag-aaral kami ng Arabo.
sentences.translation: We study Arabic.

sentences.text: Kakaunti ang tao sa dalampasigan.
sentences.translation: There were few people on the beach.

sentences.text: Nagbabakasyon ako sa dalampasigan.
sentences.translation: I am taking a holiday at the beach.

sentences.text: Maghugas ka ng kamay para mawala ang mikrobyo.
sentences.translation: Wash your hands to get rid of the germs.

sentences.text: May mikrobyo ba sa telepono ko?
sentences.translation: Are there germs on my phone?

sentences.text: Mabait ang tagapangasiwa ng paaralan namin.
sentences.translation: The administrator of our school is kind.

sentences.text: Kausapin natin ang tagapangasiwa ng tindahan.
sentences.translation: Let's talk to the manager of the store.

sentences.text: Sinunod niya ang tagubilin ng doktor.
sentences.translation: He followed the doctor's instructions.

sentences.text: Ano ang tagubilin ni Nanay bago siya umalis?
sentences.translation: What was Mother's instruction before she left?

sentences.text: Malaki at maitim ang toro sa bukid.
sentences.translation: The bull in the field is big and dark.

sentences.text: Takot ako sa toro ni Mang Ben.
sentences.translation: I am afraid of Mang Ben's bull.

sentences.text: Kailangan ko ng lagda mo rito.
sentences.translation: I need your signature here.

sentences.text: Isulat mo ang lagda mo sa ibaba.
sentences.translation: Write your signature at the bottom.

cards.gloss: to base (something) on; to use as a basis (locative focus)

sentences.text: Ano ang pagbabasehan natin ng desisyon?
sentences.translation: What will we base our decision on?

sentences.text: Pagbasehan mo ng sagot ang aklat.
sentences.translation: Base your answer on the book.

sentences.text: Isang dantaon na ang lumang tulay na ito.
sentences.translation: This old bridge is already a century old.

sentences.text: Maraming dantaon na ang nakalipas mula noon.
sentences.translation: Many centuries have passed since then.

sentences.text: Masikip ang jeep tuwing umaga.
sentences.translation: The jeepney is crowded every morning.

sentences.text: Masikip ba ang sapatos mo?
sentences.translation: Are your shoes tight?

sentences.text: Nakatali ang aso sa poste.
sentences.translation: The dog is tied to the post.

sentences.text: May ilaw sa tuktok ng poste.
sentences.translation: There is a light at the top of the pole.

cards.gloss: sulking; pouting (sullen, withdrawn behavior after being hurt)

sentences.text: Bakit may tampo ka sa akin?
sentences.translation: Why are you upset with me?

sentences.text: May tampo sa akin si Ana.
sentences.translation: Ana is upset with me.

sentences.text: Maiksi ang buhok ng kapatid ko.
sentences.translation: My sibling's hair is short.

sentences.text: Masyadong maiksi ang oras natin.
sentences.translation: Our time is too short.

sentences.text: Nabansagang traydor ang lalaki.
sentences.translation: The man was branded as a traitor.

sentences.text: Bunso ang bansag nila sa kanya.
sentences.translation: They call him by the nickname Bunso.

sentences.text: Nanalo siya ng medalya sa paligsahan.
sentences.translation: She won a medal in the competition.

sentences.text: Ilang medalya ang nakuha ng koponan?
sentences.translation: How many medals did the team get?

sentences.text: Takot ang mga bata sa kuwento tungkol sa aswang.
sentences.translation: The children are afraid of the story about the aswang.

sentences.text: Nanonood kami ng pelikula tungkol sa aswang.
sentences.translation: We are watching a movie about an aswang.

sentences.text: Ang diyosesis namin ay may dalawampung parokya.
sentences.translation: Our diocese has twenty parishes.

sentences.text: Nagdaos ng misa ang obispo para sa buong diyosesis.
sentences.translation: The bishop held a Mass for the whole diocese.

sentences.text: Madumi ang kamay ko dahil sa karbon.
sentences.translation: My hands are dirty because of the coal.

sentences.text: Kailan siya babalik?
sentences.translation: When is he coming back?

sentences.text: Kababalik ko lang.
sentences.translation: I've just come back.

sentences.text: Taos ang pasasalamat ko sa inyo.
sentences.translation: My thanks to you are heartfelt.

sentences.text: Taos ba ang paghingi niya ng tawad?
sentences.translation: Was his apology sincere?

sentences.text: Malaking alo sa akin ang yakap ni Nanay.
sentences.translation: Mom's hug is a great comfort to me.

sentences.text: Naghanap ako ng alo sa mga kaibigan ko.
sentences.translation: I looked for comfort from my friends.

cards.gloss: term of address for an older woman; older sister

sentences.text: Manang, puwede po bang magtanong?
sentences.translation: Ma'am, may I ask a question?

sentences.text: Nagluluto si Manang ng sinigang para sa amin.
sentences.translation: Manang is cooking sinigang for us.

sentences.text: Hinarangan ng guho ang daan pagkatapos ng ulan.
sentences.translation: The rubble blocked the road after the rain.

sentences.text: Ano ang sanhi ng guho ng lumang gusali?
sentences.translation: What caused the collapse of the old building?

sentences.text: Malamig ang hangin tuwing panahon ng amihan.
sentences.translation: The wind is cold during the amihan season.

sentences.text: Kailan darating ang amihan sa atin?
sentences.translation: When will the amihan arrive here?

sentences.text: May grasa ang kamay ng mekaniko.
sentences.translation: The mechanic's hands have grease on them.

sentences.text: Lagyan mo ng grasa ang kadena ng bisikleta.
sentences.translation: Put some grease on the bicycle chain.

cards.gloss: gesture of respect: pressing an elder's hand to one's forehead

sentences.text: Mano po, Lola!
sentences.translation: Your blessing, Grandma! (said while pressing her hand to one's forehead)

sentences.text: Hindi niya nakalimutang magmano kay Lolo.
sentences.translation: He did not forget to do the mano gesture for Grandpa.

sentences.text: Ang lola ko ay nakakapagmaneho ng motorsiklo.
sentences.translation: My grandmother can ride a motorcycle.

sentences.text: Hindi ko alam kung magkano ang motorsiklong ito.
sentences.translation: I don't know how much this motorcycle is.

sentences.translation: I am all alone in a foreign country.

sentences.text: Dumating siyang mag-isa.
sentences.translation: She came alone.

sentences.text: Parang may nangyayaring sobrang kakaiba sa parke.
sentences.translation: Something very unusual seems to be happening in the park.

sentences.text: Naglakad ako papunta sa parke.
sentences.translation: I walked toward the park.

sentences.text: Pumirma kami sa petisyon para sa bagong palaruan.
sentences.translation: We signed the petition for a new playground.

sentences.text: Sino ang gumawa ng petisyon sa paaralan?
sentences.translation: Who made the petition at the school?

sentences.text: Bumili kami ng isang sako ng bigas.
sentences.translation: We bought a sack of rice.

sentences.text: Mabigat ang sako, kaya tulungan mo ako.
sentences.translation: The sack is heavy, so help me.

sentences.text: Lumalaki ang sanggol sa sinapupunan ng kanyang ina.
sentences.translation: The baby grows in its mother's womb.

sentences.text: Gaano katagal nasa sinapupunan ang sanggol?
sentences.translation: How long is a baby in the womb?

cards.gloss: to give away; to distribute for free

sentences.text: Sigurado ba kayong gusto ninyong ipamigay ang lahat ng mga gamit na ito?
sentences.translation: Are you sure you want to give all this stuff away?

sentences.translation: He contributed much to the development of the economy.

sentences.text: Siya ay higit sa apatnapu.
sentences.translation: He is past forty.

sentences.text: Apatnapu ang estudyante sa klase namin.
sentences.translation: There are forty students in our class.

sentences.text: Hindi dapat mapunta sa limot ang kuwento ng pamilya natin.
sentences.translation: Our family's story should not fall into oblivion.

sentences.text: Miyembro si Tatay ng asosasyon ng mga magsasaka.
sentences.translation: Dad is a member of the farmers' association.

sentences.text: Anong asosasyon ang sinalihan mo sa paaralan?
sentences.translation: Which association did you join at school?

sentences.text: Malinaw ang deklarasyon ng saksi sa pulis.
sentences.translation: The witness's statement to the police is clear.

sentences.text: Ano ang nakasulat sa deklarasyon na ito?
sentences.translation: What is written in this declaration?

sentences.text: Binigyan ko ng kwintas na perlas ang kapatid kong babae para sa kanyang kaarawan.
sentences.translation: I gave my sister a pearl necklace on her birthday.

sentences.text: Suot ni Nanay ang kuwintas na perlas.
sentences.translation: Mom is wearing the pearl necklace.

sentences.text: Malaki ang bulwagan ng paaralan namin.
sentences.translation: Our school's hall is big.

sentences.text: Nasaan ang bulwagan para sa palabas?
sentences.translation: Where is the hall for the show?

sentences.text: Walang nakahanap ng kuweba.
sentences.translation: No one could find the cave.

sentences.text: Madilim sa loob ng kuweba.
sentences.translation: It is dark inside the cave.

sentences.text: Kukunin ko itong kayumangging kurbata.
sentences.translation: I'll take this brown tie.

sentences.text: Kayumanggi ang tinapay.
sentences.translation: The bread is brown.

sentences.text: Maraming tao sa kalye noong dumaan ang parada.
sentences.translation: There were lots of people on the street when the parade came by.

sentences.text: Hinabol ng mga bata ang parada ng sirkus.
sentences.translation: The children chased after the circus parade.

sentences.text: Bakit napakabango ng trapong hawak mo?
sentences.translation: Why does the rag in your hand smell so good?

sentences.text: Ang bango ng beefsteak na ito.
sentences.translation: This beefsteak smells good.

sentences.text: Hindi ko alam na galing pala sa binhi ang puno ng mansanas.
sentences.translation: I didn't know apple trees grow from seeds.

sentences.text: Nagtanim si Ana ng binhi ng kalabasa sa bakuran.
sentences.translation: Ana planted squash seeds in the yard.

sentences.text: Ilang dosis ng gamot ang iinumin ko bawat araw?
sentences.translation: How many doses of medicine do I take each day?

sentences.text: Huwag mong dagdagan ang dosis ng gamot mo.
sentences.translation: Do not increase your medicine dose.

sentences.text: Sira na ang kable ng charger ko.
sentences.translation: The cable of my charger is broken.

sentences.text: Pakibilhan ako ng mahabang kable para sa telebisyon.
sentences.translation: Please buy me a long cable for the television.

sentences.text: Naglagay si Nanay ng kamatis sa sinigang.
sentences.translation: Mom put tomatoes in the sinigang.

sentences.text: Magkano ang kilo ng kamatis ngayon?
sentences.translation: How much is a kilo of tomatoes today?

sentences.text: Hinila ng mga mangingisda ang lambat.
sentences.translation: The fishermen pulled in the net.

sentences.text: May butas ang lambat natin.
sentences.translation: Our net has a hole.

sentences.text: May manliligaw na si Ate.
sentences.translation: My older sister already has a suitor.

sentences.text: Sino ang manliligaw mo?
sentences.translation: Who is your suitor?

sentences.text: Pinalaki niya ang kanyang mga anak nang matapat.
sentences.translation: She brought up her children to be truthful.

sentences.text: Sa tingin ko ay matapat siya.
sentences.translation: It seems to me that he is honest.

sentences.text: Mahina na ang pandinig ni Lolo.
sentences.translation: Grandpa's hearing is weak now.

sentences.text: Mahalaga ang pandinig sa pag-aaral ng wika.
sentences.translation: Hearing is important in learning a language.

sentences.text: Maasim po ang mga ubas na ito.
sentences.translation: These grapes are sour.

sentences.text: Dyeli ng ubas ang pinakagusto ko.
sentences.translation: I like grape jelly best.

sentences.text: Maraming alam na salawikain si Lola.
sentences.translation: Grandma knows many proverbs.

sentences.text: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng salawikain na ito?
sentences.translation: What does this proverb mean?

cards.gloss: to spread; to scatter; to broadcast (object focus)

sentences.text: Ikalat mo nang pantay ang pataba sa lupa.
sentences.translation: Spread the fertilizer evenly on the soil.

sentences.text: Huwag mo munang ikalat ang balita.
sentences.translation: Don't spread the news yet.

sentences.text: Bawat salita sa diksiyunaryong ito'y importante.
sentences.translation: Every word in this dictionary is important.

sentences.text: May diksiyunaryo ako sa kamay ko.
sentences.translation: I have a dictionary in my hand.

sentences.translation: The boy swims with his friends.

sentences.text: Talagang hindi ako marunong lumangoy.
sentences.translation: I can't swim at all.

sentences.text: May bahid ng kape ang kamiseta ko.
sentences.translation: My shirt has a coffee stain.

sentences.text: Hindi matanggal ang bahid sa damit.
sentences.translation: The stain on the clothes won't come out.

cards.gloss: to move forward; to advance; to make progress

sentences.text: Ang hindi pagsulong ay pagbalik.
sentences.translation: Not to advance is to go back.

sentences.text: Ang lupit ng laro mo kanina!
sentences.translation: Your game earlier was awesome!

sentences.text: Nagulat kami sa lupit ng bagyo.
sentences.translation: We were shocked by the ferocity of the storm.

sentences.text: Durog na ang mga biskwit sa bag ko.
sentences.translation: The biscuits in my bag are already crushed.

sentences.text: Bumili ako ng durog na yelo para sa halo-halo.
sentences.translation: I bought crushed ice for the halo-halo.

sentences.text: Ayaw kong sumama sa gala nila ngayong gabi.
sentences.translation: I don't want to join their outing tonight.

sentences.text: Tama na ang gala, umuwi ka na.
sentences.translation: Enough wandering around, go home now.

sentences.text: Laging sumusunod sa araw ang mirasol.
sentences.translation: The sunflower always follows the sun.

sentences.text: Nagtanim si Lola ng mirasol sa hardin.
sentences.translation: Grandma planted sunflowers in the garden.

sentences.text: Baka may nagkamaling kumuha ng payong ko.
sentences.translation: Someone must have taken my umbrella by mistake.

sentences.text: Dinala mo ba ang payong mo?
sentences.translation: Did you bring an umbrella with you?

sentences.text: Mabuti sa sirkulasyon ng dugo ang paglalakad.
sentences.translation: Walking is good for blood circulation.

sentences.text: Kulang ang sirkulasyon ng hangin sa kuwarto.
sentences.translation: The air circulation in the room is poor.

sentences.text: Tapos na ang taglamig; tagsibol na.
sentences.translation: Winter is over and spring has come.

sentences.text: Namumulaklak ang mga halaman tuwing tagsibol.
sentences.translation: Plants bloom every spring.

sentences.text: Naharangan ng malaking trak ang kalye.
sentences.translation: The street was blocked by a huge truck.

sentences.text: Isang aso ang nasagasaan ng trak.
sentences.translation: A dog was run over by a truck.

sentences.text: Magsuot po kayo ng tsinelas.
sentences.translation: Please put on your slippers.

sentences.text: Nasaan ang isa kong tsinelas?
sentences.translation: Where is my other slipper?

sentences.text: Maglagay ka ng sapin sa mesa.
sentences.translation: Put a cover on the table.

sentences.text: Gumamit kami ng dyaryo bilang sapin sa sahig.
sentences.translation: We used newspaper as a covering on the floor.

sentences.text: Nabisto ang linlang ng nagbebenta.
sentences.translation: The seller's trickery was found out.

sentences.text: Bakit ka gumamit ng linlang para manalo?
sentences.translation: Why did you use trickery to win?

sentences.text: Tulala siya pagkatapos niyang marinig ang balita.
sentences.translation: He was dazed after hearing the news.

sentences.text: Bakit ka nakatulala diyan?
sentences.translation: Why are you staring blankly over there?

sentences.text: Magkano ang isang bote ng katas ng buko?
sentences.translation: How much is a bottle of coconut juice?

sentences.text: Gumagawa ng buko dyus si Daniel.
sentences.translation: Daniel is making coconut juice.

sentences.text: Kaunti ang impormasyon nila sa heograpiya.
sentences.translation: They had little information about geography.

sentences.text: Paborito kong asignatura ang heograpiya.
sentences.translation: Geography is my favorite subject.

cards.gloss: so to speak; as if; it's like

sentences.text: Kumbaga sa bahay, siya ang haligi ng pamilya.
sentences.translation: If the family were a house, he would be its pillar.

sentences.text: Kumbaga sa laro, ako ang huling manlalaro.
sentences.translation: If life were a game, I would be the last player.

sentences.text: Siya si Mei. Nagluluto siya sa kusina.
sentences.translation: She is called Mei. She is cooking in the kitchen.

sentences.text: Nagluluto ng almusal ang nanay ko.
sentences.translation: My mother is cooking breakfast.

sentences.text: Dumating ang mga mananakop sa isla noon.
sentences.translation: The conquerors arrived on the island long ago.

sentences.text: Lumaban ang bayan sa mga mananakop.
sentences.translation: The town fought against the occupiers.

sentences.text: Hindi ko alam kung magkano yang dalawan bike na yan.
sentences.translation: I don't know how much those two bikes cost.

sentences.text: Dinalaw ni Datu si Alvin.
sentences.translation: Datu visited Alvin.

sentences.text: Gusto kong sumali sa hukbong panghimpapawid.
sentences.translation: I want to join the air force.

sentences.text: Ang kuya ko ay nasa Hukbong Panghimpapawid.
sentences.translation: My older brother is in the Air Force.

sentences.text: Nakilala siya ng marami sa loob ng teatro.
sentences.translation: Many in the theater recognized him.

sentences.text: Dati, bukas ang teatro kahit Sabado.
sentences.translation: The theater used to be open even on Saturdays.

sentences.text: Paano ba ako yayaman?
sentences.translation: How can I become rich?

sentences.text: Yumaman ang tito ko dahil sa negosyo niya.
sentences.translation: My uncle became rich because of his business.

sentences.translation: Both my father and my brother like gambling.

sentences.text: Malaking sugal ang paglipat ko ng trabaho.
sentences.translation: Changing jobs is a big gamble for me.

sentences.text: Nagbabantay ang tanod sa kalsada tuwing gabi.
sentences.translation: The watchman guards the street every night.

sentences.text: Tawagin natin ang tanod, may nawawalang bata.
sentences.translation: Let's call the barangay tanod, a child is missing.

sentences.text: Hindi ko pagdududahan ang sinabi mo.
sentences.translation: I won't doubt what you said.

sentences.text: Bakit mo pagdududahan ang sarili mo?
sentences.translation: Why would you doubt yourself?

sentences.translation: The child doesn't want to swallow the medicine.

sentences.text: Nguyain mo muna bago mo lunukin ang pagkain.
sentences.translation: Chew first before you swallow the food.

sentences.text: Hindi ako humihingi ng ganti sa kabutihan.
sentences.translation: I don't ask for repayment for kindness.

sentences.text: Libre ko ang tanghalian bilang ganti sa tulong mo.
sentences.translation: Lunch is on me in return for your help.

sentences.text: Sarado ang puwerto sa paglalayag.
sentences.translation: The harbor is closed to navigation.

sentences.text: Inumbok ng hangin ang layag.
sentences.translation: A gust of wind swelled the sails.

cards.gloss: influx; sudden large arrival (of people, goods); abundance

sentences.text: Dagsa ang tao sa mall tuwing Pasko.
sentences.translation: There is a flood of people at the mall every Christmas.

sentences.text: May dagsa ng mga turista tuwing tag-init.
sentences.translation: There is an influx of tourists every summer.

cards.gloss: complaint; report made against someone; tattling

sentences.text: Narinig ng guro ang sumbong ng bata.
sentences.translation: The teacher heard the child's complaint.

sentences.text: Ano ang sumbong mo kay Nanay?
sentences.translation: What are you reporting to Mom?

sentences.text: Ano ang plaka ng kotse mo?
sentences.translation: What is your car's license plate?

sentences.text: May lumang plaka si Lolo na pinapatugtog niya.
sentences.translation: Grandpa has an old record that he plays.

sentences.translation: We bought decorations for Christmas.

sentences.text: Saan ang bagong tambayan ninyo?
sentences.translation: Where is your new hangout spot?

sentences.translation: Daniel is making ube cake.

sentences.text: Kapag hinalo mo ang asul at pula, ang resulta ay kulay ube.
sentences.translation: If you mix blue and red, the result is purple.

sentences.translation: Did Tom help his mother yesterday?

sentences.translation: I had to help her.

sentences.translation: Is the lead in the movie you watched heroic?

sentences.translation: The eagle flew over the mountain.

sentences.text: Nakakita ka na ba ng agila?
sentences.translation: Have you ever seen an eagle?

sentences.text: Naglalaro kami ng badminton tuwing Sabado.
sentences.translation: We play badminton every Saturday.

sentences.text: Marunong ka bang maglaro ng badminton?
sentences.translation: Do you know how to play badminton?

sentences.translation: Our class joined the balagtasan.

sentences.translation: The flood is a big obstacle to us getting to school.

sentences.translation: How much is the fare on the jeepney?

sentences.translation: I also heard a similar story.

sentences.translation: What time will the clinic open tomorrow?

sentences.translation: Grandpa likes to watch comedies on television.

sentences.translation: Which comedy do you want to watch tonight?

sentences.translation: The leaf is sticky.

sentences.translation: Let's get lost in our own minds.

sentences.translation: He believes that he is a hero.

sentences.translation: What he said in the speech was all just rhetoric.

sentences.text: Pinag-aaralan namin ang retorika sa klase ngayong semestre.
sentences.translation: We are studying rhetoric in class this semester.

sentences.translation: Mom put rosemary on the roasted chicken.

sentences.text: Itinanim namin ang romero sa paso malapit sa bintana.
sentences.translation: We planted the rosemary in a pot near the window.

sentences.translation: My child likes the story about the mermaid in the sea.

sentences.translation: Let's look at the chart on the board.

sentences.translation: The teacher made a chart of our grades.

sentences.translation: Where is Grandma's walking stick?

sentences.translation: The village is short of water every summer.

sentences.text: Salat sila sa pera kaya nagtitipid sila.
sentences.translation: They are short of money, so they save.

sentences.translation: I am grilling fish.

sentences.translation: There is a pile of sand beside the house.
