sentences.text: Gusto kong maging beterinaryo paglaki ko.
sentences.translation: I want to be a veterinarian when I grow up.

sentences.text: Ano ang kahulugan ng salitang ito?
sentences.translation: What is the meaning of this word?

sentences.text: Ano ang kasingkahulugan ng salitang masaya?
sentences.translation: What is the synonym of the word masaya?

sentences.text: Naglakad kaming palibot ng lawa.
sentences.translation: We've walked all around the lake.

sentences.text: Bawal lumangoy sa lawa.
sentences.translation: Swimming in the lake is forbidden.

sentences.text: Bawal ang pestisidyo sa organikong sakahan.
sentences.translation: Pesticides are not allowed on an organic farm.

sentences.text: Hinugasan ni Nanay ang gulay para matanggal ang pestisidyo.
sentences.translation: Mom washed the vegetables to remove the pesticide.

sentences.text: Hawak ng mang-aawit ang mikropono.
sentences.translation: The singer is holding the microphone.

sentences.text: Bakit ayaw gumana ng mikropono?
sentences.translation: Why won't the microphone work?

sentences.text: Panatiko siya ng siyensiyang piksiyon.
sentences.translation: He's a science fiction fanatic.

sentences.text: Panatiko ng basketbol ang tatay ko.
sentences.translation: My father is a basketball fanatic.

cards.gloss: to make someone happy; to cheer up (object focus)

sentences.text: Huwag kang mag-alala, magpakasaya ka!
sentences.translation: Don't worry, be happy!

sentences.text: Bakit ang saya-saya ninyo?
sentences.translation: Why are you all so happy?

sentences.text: Matamis ang peras na binili ko sa palengke.
sentences.translation: The pear I bought at the market is sweet.

sentences.text: Gusto mo ba ng peras o mansanas?
sentences.translation: Do you want a pear or an apple?

sentences.text: Pulos tubig ang laman ng baso.
sentences.translation: The glass contains nothing but water.

sentences.text: Pulos laro na lang ba ang ginagawa mo?
sentences.translation: Do you do nothing but play?

sentences.text: May susog ka ba sa plano natin?
sentences.translation: Do you have an amendment to our plan?

sentences.text: Tinanggap ng klase ang susog ni Ana.
sentences.translation: The class accepted Ana's amendment.

sentences.text: Ikaw ang toka sa paghuhugas ng plato ngayon.
sentences.translation: It's your turn to wash the dishes today.

sentences.text: Kaninong toka ang magbantay ng tindahan?
sentences.translation: Whose turn is it to watch the store?

sentences.text: Suplado ang bagong kaklase namin.
sentences.translation: Our new classmate is snobbish.

sentences.text: Bakit ba suplado si Ate ngayon?
sentences.translation: Why is Sister so aloof today?

sentences.text: Obligado ang lahat na magsuot ng helmet.
sentences.translation: Everyone is obliged to wear a helmet.

sentences.text: Hindi ka obligadong sumama sa amin.
sentences.translation: You are not obliged to come with us.

cards.gloss: to replace with an equivalent; to repay in kind (locative focus)

sentences.text: Paano ko matutumbasan ang tulong ninyo?
sentences.translation: How can I repay your help?

sentences.text: Tumbasan mo ang kabutihan ng kaibigan mo.
sentences.translation: Repay your friend's kindness in kind.

sentences.text: Humingi siya ng basbas sa kanyang mga magulang.
sentences.translation: He asked his parents for their blessing.

sentences.text: Ibinigay ng may-ari ang basbas niya sa plano namin.
sentences.translation: The owner gave his approval to our plan.

sentences.text: Gawa sa abaka ang bag na ito.
sentences.translation: This bag is made of abaca.

sentences.text: Nagtatanim sila ng abaka sa Bicol.
sentences.translation: They grow abaca in Bicol.

sentences.text: Naniniwala ang bata na may ada sa hardin.
sentences.translation: The child believes there is a fairy in the garden.

sentences.text: May pakpak ang ada sa kuwento.
sentences.translation: The fairy in the story has wings.

sentences.text: May rebulto ng arkanghel sa harap ng simbahan.
sentences.translation: There is a statue of an archangel in front of the church.

sentences.text: Binanggit ng pari ang arkanghel sa kanyang homiliya.
sentences.translation: The priest mentioned the archangel in his homily.

sentences.text: Narito pa ang bag niya, kaya hindi maaaring nakapunta na siya ng paaralan.
sentences.translation: His bag is right here, so he cannot have gone to school yet.

sentences.text: Kailangan mo nang magsimula ng bagong negosyo.
sentences.translation: It is high time you started a new business.

sentences.text: Mas gusto niya ang sago at gulaman.
sentences.translation: He likes sago and gulaman (agar jelly) better.

sentences.text: Gusto ko ng malamig na gulaman ngayong tag-init.
sentences.translation: I want cold agar jelly this summer.

sentences.text: Naghintay ako ng sampung minuto.
sentences.translation: I waited for ten minutes.

sentences.text: Sampung beses na mas maraming salitang Ingles ang alam niya kaysa sa akin.
sentences.translation: She knows ten times as many English words as I do.

sentences.text: Integral na bahagi ng pamilya namin si Lolo.
sentences.translation: Grandpa is an integral part of our family.

sentences.text: Integral ba ang pagtutulungan sa trabaho ninyo?
sentences.translation: Is teamwork integral to your work?

sentences.text: Mula sa kaibuturan ng puso ko, salamat po.
sentences.translation: From the depths of my heart, thank you.

sentences.text: Nakarating sila sa kaibuturan ng gubat.
sentences.translation: They reached the depths of the forest.

sentences.text: Mas gusto ni Gabriel ang katas ng kalamansi.
sentences.translation: Gabriel prefers the calamansi juice.

sentences.text: Gumagawa ng kalamansi dyus si Daniel.
sentences.translation: Daniel is making calamansi juice.

sentences.text: May modelong kalansay sa silid-aralan namin.
sentences.translation: There is a skeleton model in our classroom.

sentences.text: Nakita namin ang kalansay ng isda sa dalampasigan.
sentences.translation: We saw a fish skeleton on the beach.

sentences.text: May kalyo na ang mga kamay ko sa kakatrabaho.
sentences.translation: My hands have calluses from all the work.

sentences.text: Masakit ba ang kalyo sa paa mo?
sentences.translation: Does the callus on your foot hurt?

sentences.text: Naputol ang isang kawing ng kadena.
sentences.translation: One link of the chain broke.

sentences.text: Bawat kawing ng kadena ay mahalaga.
sentences.translation: Every link of the chain is important.

sentences.text: Namamaga ang kulani sa leeg niya.
sentences.translation: The gland in his neck is swollen.

sentences.text: Sinuri ng doktor ang kulani ko.
sentences.translation: The doctor examined my lymph node.

sentences.text: Nabasag ang lente ng salamin ko.
sentences.translation: The lens of my glasses broke.

sentences.text: Gumamit siya ng lente para tingnan ang langgam.
sentences.translation: He used a magnifying glass to look at the ant.

sentences.text: Biglang naglaho ang usok sa hangin.
sentences.translation: The smoke suddenly vanished into the air.

sentences.text: Maglalaho ba ang sakit na ito?
sentences.translation: Will this pain go away?

sentences.text: Mutya ng pamilya ang bunso naming kapatid.
sentences.translation: Our youngest sibling is the darling of the family.

sentences.text: Malapit sa bahay namin ang sekundaryang paaralan.
sentences.translation: The secondary school is near our house.

sentences.text: Saang sekundaryang paaralan ka nag-aral?
sentences.translation: Which high school did you attend?

cards.gloss: held in the hand; something held in one's hand

sentences.text: Pulang payong ang tangan ni Ana.
sentences.translation: What Ana is holding is a red umbrella.

sentences.text: Mabilis ang transaksiyon namin sa bangko kanina.
sentences.translation: Our transaction at the bank earlier was quick.

sentences.text: Puwede ko bang makita ang resibo ng transaksiyon ko?
sentences.translation: May I see the receipt for my transaction?

sentences.text: Hindi mo mapipiga ang dugo galing sa bato.
sentences.translation: You cannot get blood out of a stone.

sentences.text: Masakit sa kamay ang piga ng maraming damit.
sentences.translation: Wringing out a lot of clothes hurts the hands.

sentences.text: Dalawang tiket para sa adulto at isa para sa bata, po.
sentences.translation: Two tickets for adults and one for a child, please.

sentences.text: Tumulong ang mga adulto sa paglilinis ng parke.
sentences.translation: The adults helped clean the park.

sentences.text: Maayos ang tiklop ng mga damit sa aparador.
sentences.translation: The fold of the clothes in the closet is neat.

sentences.text: May tiklop sa gitna ng mapa.
sentences.translation: There is a fold in the middle of the map.

sentences.text: Umakyat ang baging sa bakod namin.
sentences.translation: A vine climbed up our fence.

sentences.text: Tumagal ng isang buwan ang kubkob sa lungsod.
sentences.translation: The siege of the city lasted a month.

sentences.text: Nabasa namin sa aklat ng kasaysayan ang kubkob sa kastilyo.
sentences.translation: We read about the siege of the castle in the history book.

sentences.text: Nagpasa ako ng analisis ng kuwento sa guro namin.
sentences.translation: I handed in an analysis of the story to our teacher.

sentences.text: Kailangan pa ng masusing analisis ang resulta ng pagsusulit.
sentences.translation: The test results still need a careful analysis.

sentences.text: Isang kilalang istoryador ang bisita sa klase namin.
sentences.translation: A well-known historian is the guest in our class.

sentences.text: Gusto kong maging istoryador paglaki ko.
sentences.translation: I want to be a historian when I grow up.

sentences.text: Nilagay ko ang pera sa kaha de yero.
sentences.translation: I put the money into the safe.

sentences.text: Itinago ng may-ari ang pera sa kaha ng tindahan.
sentences.translation: The owner kept the money in the store's cash box.

sentences.text: Ano ang ari-arian?
sentences.translation: What is property?

sentences.text: Nanalo ang koponan namin sa kampeonato.
sentences.translation: Our team won the championship.

sentences.text: Kailan ang laro para sa kampeonato?
sentences.translation: When is the game for the championship?

sentences.text: Maalamat na ang restawran na ito sa aming bayan.
sentences.translation: This restaurant is already legendary in our town.

sentences.text: Napanood mo na ba ang maalamat na larong iyon?
sentences.translation: Have you watched that legendary game?

cards.gloss: to reduce; to cut down; to subtract; (euphemism) to relieve oneself

sentences.text: Gusto kong magbawas ng asukal sa kape.
sentences.translation: I want to cut down on the sugar in my coffee.

sentences.text: Magsalita ka nang mahinhin.
sentences.translation: Speak softly.

sentences.text: Mahinhin kumilos ang bago naming kapitbahay.
sentences.translation: Our new neighbor carries herself demurely.

cards.gloss: to be contented; to be satisfied

sentences.text: Kontento ba siya?
sentences.translation: Is he satisfied?

sentences.text: Kontento ka ba sa kasalukuyan mong sweldo?
sentences.translation: Are you content with your present salary?

sentences.text: Matalas ang pangil ng aso.
sentences.translation: The dog's fangs are sharp.

sentences.text: Anong hayop ang may mahabang pangil?
sentences.translation: Which animal has long tusks?

sentences.text: Kausap ng paroko ang mga tao sa labas ng simbahan.
sentences.translation: The parish priest is talking with the people outside the church.

sentences.text: Ang paroko ng aming bayan ay nagmimisa tuwing umaga.
sentences.translation: Our town's parish priest says Mass every morning.

sentences.text: Naospital si Lolo dahil sa pulmonya.
sentences.translation: Grandpa was hospitalized because of pneumonia.

sentences.text: Puwedeng maging pulmonya ang matagal na ubo.
sentences.translation: A cough that lasts long can turn into pneumonia.

sentences.text: May raket si Ben tuwing Sabado.
sentences.translation: Ben has a side job every Saturday.

sentences.text: Naghahanap ako ng raket ngayong bakasyon.
sentences.translation: I'm looking for a side job this vacation.

sentences.text: Ang puso ay signo ng pagmamahal.
sentences.translation: The heart is a symbol of love.

sentences.text: Ano ang ibig sabihin ng signo na ito?
sentences.translation: What does this sign mean?

sentences.text: Maglagay ka ng tubig sa timba.
sentences.translation: Put some water in the bucket.

sentences.text: Bumili si Nanay ng bagong timba sa palengke.
sentences.translation: Mom bought a new pail at the market.

cards.gloss: to speed up; to make faster (object focus)

sentences.text: Nag-iiba ang daigdig nang pabilis nang pabilis.
sentences.translation: The world changes faster and faster.

sentences.text: Kailangan niyang tumakbo ng napakabilis?
sentences.translation: Does he need to run so fast?

sentences.text: Maamo ang aso ng kapitbahay namin.
sentences.translation: Our neighbor's dog is gentle.

sentences.text: Maamo ba ang kabayong ito?
sentences.translation: Is this horse docile?

sentences.text: Nilagyan ni Nanay ng almirol ang uniporme ko.
sentences.translation: Mom put starch on my uniform.

sentences.text: Bumili ka ng almirol sa tindahan.
sentences.translation: Buy some laundry starch at the store.

sentences.text: Amoy asupre ang tubig sa bukal.
sentences.translation: The water in the hot spring smells like sulfur.

sentences.text: Ginagamit ang asupre sa paggawa ng posporo.
sentences.translation: Sulfur is used in making matches.

sentences.text: Nagsuot si Lola ng balabal dahil malamig.
sentences.translation: Grandma wore a shawl because it was cold.

sentences.text: Puwede ko bang hiramin ang balabal mo?
sentences.translation: Can I borrow your shawl?

sentences.text: Isinulat ng botante ang pangalan sa balota.
sentences.translation: The voter wrote the name on the ballot.

sentences.text: Inilagay ni Ana ang balota sa kahon.
sentences.translation: Ana put the ballot in the box.

sentences.text: May nakita akong mga bibe sa lawa sa liwasan malapit sa aklatan.
sentences.translation: I saw some ducks on the pond in the park near the library.

sentences.text: Lumalangoy ang mga bibe sa sapa.
sentences.translation: The ducks are swimming in the stream.

sentences.text: Muntik nang mahulog ang bata sa bingit ng bangin.
sentences.translation: The child almost fell off the edge of the cliff.

sentences.text: Nasa bingit na ng pagkalugi ang tindahan.
sentences.translation: The store is on the brink of going bankrupt.

sentences.text: Mag-ingat ka, may bubog sa sahig.
sentences.translation: Be careful, there is broken glass on the floor.

sentences.text: Nagwalis si Tatay ng bubog ng nabasag na baso.
sentences.translation: Dad swept up the shards of the broken glass.

sentences.text: Inmoral ang mandaya sa pagsusulit.
sentences.translation: Cheating on a test is immoral.

sentences.text: Sa tingin mo, inmoral ba ang magsinungaling?
sentences.translation: Do you think lying is immoral?

sentences.text: Magandang inisyatiba ang paglilinis ng kalsada.
sentences.translation: Cleaning the street is a good initiative.

sentences.text: Nagpakita ng inisyatiba si Ana sa trabaho.
sentences.translation: Ana showed initiative at work.

sentences.text: Umupo ang bata sa kandungan ni Nanay.
sentences.translation: The child sat on Mom's lap.

sentences.text: Natutulog ang pusa sa kandungan ko.
sentences.translation: The cat is sleeping on my lap.

sentences.text: Uminom ka ng isang kapsula pagkatapos kumain.
sentences.translation: Take one capsule after eating.

sentences.text: Malaki ang kapsulang ito at mahirap lunukin.
sentences.translation: This capsule is big and hard to swallow.

sentences.text: Dati, takot ang mga tao sa ketong.
sentences.translation: In the past, people were afraid of leprosy.

sentences.text: Nagagamot na ngayon ang ketong.
sentences.translation: Leprosy can be treated now.

sentences.text: Wala akong gaanong kumpiyansa.
sentences.translation: I don't have much confidence.

sentences.text: Malaki ang kumpiyansa niya bago ang pagsusulit.
sentences.translation: He had a lot of confidence before the exam.

cards.gloss: to be able to pay; to be paid off

sentences.text: Babayaran niya ang lahat.
sentences.translation: She will pay for everything.

sentences.text: Nagbayad ang lahat.
sentences.translation: Everybody paid.

sentences.text: Tumigil siyang magdaldal.
sentences.translation: He stopped talking.

sentences.text: Di ka ba sasama sa aming pagdaldalan?
sentences.translation: Won't you join our conversation?

sentences.text: Prayoridad ko ang kalusugan ng pamilya ko.
sentences.translation: My family's health is my priority.

sentences.text: Ano ang unang prayoridad natin ngayong linggo?
sentences.translation: What is our first priority this week?

sentences.text: Kinausap ko ang sikyu sa may pinto.
sentences.translation: I talked to the guard by the door.

sentences.text: Tanungin mo ang sikyu kung nasaan ang banyo.
sentences.translation: Ask the guard where the restroom is.

sentences.text: Punasan mo ang uhog ng bata.
sentences.translation: Wipe the child's snot.

sentences.text: Maraming uhog si Ben dahil may sipon siya.
sentences.translation: Ben has a lot of snot because he has a cold.

sentences.text: Hinahangaan ng guro ang sigasig ng mga estudyante.
sentences.translation: The teacher admires the students' diligence.

sentences.text: Nag-aaral si Ana nang may sigasig.
sentences.translation: Ana studies with enthusiasm.

sentences.text: Kailangan kong maghanapbuhay para sa pamilya ko.
sentences.translation: I need to earn a living for my family.

sentences.text: Saan ka naghahanapbuhay ngayon?
sentences.translation: Where are you earning your living now?

sentences.text: Binisita namin ang amain ko noong Linggo.
sentences.translation: We visited my stepfather on Sunday.

sentences.text: Mabait ang amain ni Ana sa kaniya.
sentences.translation: Ana's stepfather is kind to her.

sentences.text: Nagkaroon ng areglo ang dalawang magkapitbahay.
sentences.translation: The two neighbors reached a settlement.

sentences.text: Gusto ba ninyo ng areglo para matapos na ito?
sentences.translation: Do you want a compromise so this can be over?

sentences.text: Ayaw ni Lola sa mga babaero.
sentences.translation: Grandma doesn't like womanizers.

sentences.text: Totoo bang babaero si Ben?
sentences.translation: Is it true that Ben is a womanizer?

sentences.text: Mahirap para sa akin ang balarila ng Ingles.
sentences.translation: English grammar is hard for me.

sentences.text: Nag-aaral kami ng balarila sa klase ngayon.
sentences.translation: We are studying grammar in class today.

sentences.text: Maglakad ka sa bangketa, hindi sa kalsada.
sentences.translation: Walk on the sidewalk, not in the street.

sentences.text: Maraming nagtitinda sa bangketa malapit sa palengke.
sentences.translation: Many vendors sell on the sidewalk near the market.

sentences.text: Nagmartsa ang mga puwersang Hapones patungo sa Burma.
sentences.translation: Japanese forces marched into Burma.

sentences.text: Ang Burma ay bansa sa Timog-Silangang Asya.
sentences.translation: Burma is a country in Southeast Asia.

sentences.text: Manonood kami ng dula sa dulaan mamayang gabi.
sentences.translation: We will watch a play at the theater tonight.

sentences.text: Malapit ba ang dulaan sa inyong paaralan?
sentences.translation: Is the theater close to your school?

sentences.text: Gamay na gamay na ako sa bago kong trabaho.
sentences.translation: I'm already very used to my new job.

sentences.text: Gamay mo na ba ang daan papunta rito?
sentences.translation: Are you familiar with the way here yet?

sentences.text: Nasa ikasiyam na palapag ang opisina namin.
sentences.translation: Our office is on the ninth floor.

cards.gloss: to get angry because of; to cause anger

sentences.text: Galit siya sa akin.
sentences.translation: She is angry with me.

sentences.text: Bakit sila galit?
sentences.translation: Why are they mad?

sentences.text: Nakatanggap ng insentibo ang mga empleyado.
sentences.translation: The employees received an incentive.

sentences.text: May insentibo ba para sa maagang pagbabayad?
sentences.translation: Is there an incentive for paying early?

sentences.text: Hindi ako nag-iisa; agapay ko ang kaibigan ko.
sentences.translation: I'm not alone; my friend is right beside me.

sentences.text: Hinding-hindi na ako magkaka-anak na babae.
sentences.translation: I won't ever have a daughter.

sentences.text: Mayroon kaming isang anak na lalaki at isang anak na babae.
sentences.translation: We have a son and a daughter.

sentences.text: Sa pagpasok niya sa kamalig, may nakita siyang isang nawawalang bisikleta.
sentences.translation: On entering the barn, he found a missing bike.

sentences.text: Nakaimbak ang palay sa kamalig.
sentences.translation: The rice is stored in the granary.

cards.gloss: (slang) can do it; can manage; can handle

sentences.text: Keri mo bang buhatin ito?
sentences.translation: Can you handle lifting this?

sentences.text: Keri ko ito, huwag kang mag-alala.
sentences.translation: I can handle this, don't worry.

sentences.text: Tumawag kami ng kontratista para ayusin ang bubong.
sentences.translation: We called a contractor to fix the roof.

sentences.text: Mabilis magtrabaho ang kontratista namin.
sentences.translation: Our contractor works fast.

sentences.text: Mag-ingat ka sa kurba ng daan.
sentences.translation: Be careful of the curve in the road.

sentences.text: Bumagal ang takbo ng bus sa kurba.
sentences.translation: The bus slowed down at the curve.

cards.gloss: to make happy; to cheer up (actor focus)

sentences.text: Sayang na di ko masyadong maintindihan ang Ingles.
sentences.translation: It's a pity that I don't understand English well.

sentences.text: Bakit ang saya-saya ninyo?
sentences.translation: Why are you all so happy?

sentences.text: May sakit ang mundong ito.
sentences.translation: This world is diseased.

sentences.text: Ito'y maliit na mundo.
sentences.translation: It's a small world.

cards.gloss: to befriend; to make friends with

sentences.text: Tumawag si Ming sa kaibigan niya kagabi.
sentences.translation: Ming called her friend last night.

sentences.text: Marapat lang na magpasalamat tayo sa kanila.
sentences.translation: It is only fitting that we thank them.

sentences.text: Marapat siyang tumanggap ng gantimpala.
sentences.translation: She deserves to receive a prize.

sentences.text: May nahanap akong isang mahusay na Mehikanong karinderya.
sentences.translation: I found a good Mexican restaurant.

sentences.text: Nakapunta na ako sa Mehiko, ngunit gusto kong bisitahin pa ang Guatemala.
sentences.translation: I've been to Mexico, but I would like to visit Guatemala.

sentences.text: Nagluto si Nanay ng menudo para sa tanghalian.
sentences.translation: Mom cooked menudo for lunch.

sentences.text: Gusto mo ba ng menudo o adobo?
sentences.translation: Do you want menudo or adobo?

sentences.text: Huwag kang magsiwalat ng sikreto namin.
sentences.translation: Don't reveal our secret.

sentences.text: Hindi pa siya handang magsiwalat ng totoo.
sentences.translation: He isn't ready to reveal the truth yet.

cards.gloss: pulling something out of a pocket or bag; pickpocketing

sentences.text: May senyales na uulan mamaya.
sentences.translation: There are signs that it will rain later.

sentences.text: Senyales iyon na gusto na niyang umuwi.
sentences.translation: That was a sign that he wanted to go home.

sentences.text: Siyanga, tama ka.
sentences.translation: Indeed, you're right.

sentences.text: Siyanga, mainit talaga ngayon.
sentences.translation: That's true, it really is hot today.

sentences.text: Natatakam ako sa hinog na mangga.
sentences.translation: I'm craving a ripe mango.

sentences.text: Nakakatakam ang amoy ng adobo.
sentences.translation: The smell of adobo is mouthwatering.

cards.gloss: father (term of address); respectful address for an older man

sentences.text: Magandang umaga po, Tatang.
sentences.translation: Good morning, sir.

sentences.text: Tatang, saan po kayo pupunta?
sentences.translation: Sir, where are you going?

sentences.text: Nag-aaral kami ng tayutay sa klase ng Filipino.
sentences.translation: We are studying figures of speech in Filipino class.

sentences.text: Anong tayutay ang ginamit sa tulang ito?
sentences.translation: What figure of speech is used in this poem?

sentences.text: Namamaga ang kamay ko dahil sa tibo ng bubuyog.
sentences.translation: My hand is swollen from the bee sting.

sentences.text: Masakit ba ang tibo ng isdang iyan?
sentences.translation: Does the sting of that fish hurt?

sentences.text: Mukhang talagang bata ang titser namin.
sentences.translation: Our teacher looks very young.

sentences.text: Alam kong titser ka.
sentences.translation: I know that you are a teacher.

sentences.text: Malawak po ang teritoryo ng Tsina, kaya iba-iba ang uri ng tsaa.
sentences.translation: China's territory is vast, thus the types of tea vary.

sentences.text: Ang ganyang uri ng laruan ay may masamang impluwensiya sa mga kabataan.
sentences.translation: Such toys have a bad influence on children.

cards.gloss: to beautify oneself; to make something beautiful

sentences.text: Napakaganda ng mga bituin!
sentences.translation: The stars are so beautiful!

sentences.text: Dahil sa napakaganda ng panahon, pwede ba akong magbukas ng isang bintana?
sentences.translation: Since the weather is so good, can I open a window?

sentences.text: Natuto na ang bata ng abakada.
sentences.translation: The child has learned the alphabet.

sentences.text: Kabisado mo ba ang abakada?
sentences.translation: Do you know the alphabet by heart?

sentences.text: Hinuli ng mga pulis ang bandido.
sentences.translation: The police caught the bandit.

sentences.text: Sa pelikula, may bandido sa bundok.
sentences.translation: In the movie, there is a bandit in the mountains.

sentences.text: Hindi siya nagpaligoy-ligoy.
sentences.translation: He did not beat around the bush.

sentences.text: Sumagot siya sa tanong nang walang paligoy-ligoy.
sentences.translation: He answered the question without beating around the bush.

cards.gloss: to litter; to make a mess; (colloquial) to perform badly

sentences.text: Magtutulungan tayo para linisin lahat ng kalat na 'yon.
sentences.translation: We will work together to clean all that mess.

sentences.text: Huwag kayong magkalat ng basura sa kalsada.
sentences.translation: Don't litter in the street.

sentences.text: Masarap ang lomi kapag malamig ang panahon.
sentences.translation: Lomi is delicious when the weather is cold.

sentences.text: Gusto kong kumain ng mainit na lomi.
sentences.translation: I want to eat some hot lomi.

sentences.text: Putol ang tangkay ng rosas.
sentences.translation: The stem of the rose is broken.

sentences.text: Hawakan mo ang tangkay ng payong.
sentences.translation: Hold the handle of the umbrella.

sentences.text: Mahina ang transmisyon ng radyo dito.
sentences.translation: The radio transmission is weak here.

sentences.text: Maganda ba ang transmisyon ng telebisyon ninyo?
sentences.translation: Is the broadcast on your television good?

cards.gloss: to set aside; to put aside; to rule out

sentences.text: Isantabi mo muna ang telepono habang kumakain.
sentences.translation: Put your phone aside while eating.

sentences.text: Isinantabi niya ang laro para mag-aral.
sentences.translation: He set the game aside to study.

sentences.text: Narinig ko ang kalabog sa kusina.
sentences.translation: I heard a thud in the kitchen.

sentences.text: Ano ang kalabog na iyon sa itaas?
sentences.translation: What was that bang upstairs?

sentences.text: Huwag mong ihalintulad ang kapatid mo sa iba.
sentences.translation: Don't compare your sibling to others.

sentences.text: Ihinalintulad ng guro ang buhay sa isang paglalakbay.
sentences.translation: The teacher compared life to a journey.

sentences.text: Lumpo ang isang paa ng pusa namin.
sentences.translation: One of our cat's legs is lame.

sentences.text: Tinulungan namin ang lumpong aso.
sentences.translation: We helped the crippled dog.

sentences.text: Bulilit pa ang kapatid ko.
sentences.translation: My sibling is still a little kid.

sentences.text: Ang bulilit ng sapatos ng sanggol!
sentences.translation: The baby's shoes are so tiny!

sentences.text: Nagtatrabaho si Tatay sa tibagan malapit sa bayan.
sentences.translation: Dad works at the quarry near town.

sentences.text: Malayo ba ang tibagan mula rito?
sentences.translation: Is the quarry far from here?

sentences.text: Malaki ang daluyong sa dagat kagabi.
sentences.translation: The waves at sea were huge last night.

sentences.text: Natakot ang mga mangingisda sa daluyong.
sentences.translation: The fishermen were afraid of the storm surge.

sentences.text: Nilagdaan ng hari ang bagong dekreto.
sentences.translation: The king signed the new decree.

sentences.text: Ano ang nakasulat sa dekretong ito?
sentences.translation: What is written in this decree?

sentences.text: Nagsalita ang ebanghelista sa harap ng maraming tao.
sentences.translation: The evangelist spoke in front of many people.

sentences.text: Dumalaw sa aming bayan ang isang ebanghelista.
sentences.translation: An evangelist visited our town.

sentences.text: Naniniwala si Lola sa gayuma.
sentences.translation: Grandma believes in love potions.

sentences.text: May gayuma ba ang pagkaing ito?
sentences.translation: Is there a love potion in this food?

sentences.text: Pumutok ang globo ng bata.
sentences.translation: The child's balloon popped.

sentences.text: Bumili si Ana ng pulang globo para sa party.
sentences.translation: Ana bought a red balloon for the party.

sentences.text: Ramdam ko ang hapis niya sa pagkawala ng aso.
sentences.translation: I can feel her grief over the loss of the dog.

sentences.text: Napuno ng hapis ang puso ni Lola.
sentences.translation: Grandma's heart was filled with sorrow.

cards.gloss: subsiding; abatement (of a storm or flood)

sentences.text: Humupa ang bagyo.
sentences.translation: The storm has died down.

sentences.text: Hindi na natin kailangan pang lumikas sapagkat humupa na ang baha.
sentences.translation: We don't need to evacuate anymore since the flood has already subsided.

sentences.text: Tiwasay ang buhay sa probinsya.
sentences.translation: Life in the province is peaceful.

sentences.text: Gusto ko ng tiwasay na umaga sa tabing-dagat.
sentences.translation: I want a calm morning by the beach.

sentences.text: Ang daming linta sa aking bukid.
sentences.translation: There are many leeches in my farm.

sentences.text: May linta sa paa ko pagkatapos naming tumawid sa sapa.
sentences.translation: There was a leech on my foot after we crossed the stream.

cards.gloss: to throw away; to throw; to discard

sentences.text: Huwag magtapon ng basura dito.
sentences.translation: Don't throw trash here.

sentences.text: Magtapon ka ng basura sa tamang lalagyan.
sentences.translation: Throw your trash in the right bin.

sentences.text: Kawawang pusa! Hindi niya mahuli ang maliksing daga.
sentences.translation: Poor cat! She can't catch the nimble mouse.

sentences.text: Maliksi ang pusa kapag naghahabol ng daga.
sentences.translation: The cat is nimble when it chases a mouse.

sentences.translation: The messenger brought a letter to Grandpa.

sentences.text: Dumating na ba ang mensahero?
sentences.translation: Has the messenger arrived yet?

sentences.text: Minero si Tatay sa bundok.
sentences.translation: Dad is a miner in the mountains.

sentences.text: Pagod ang mga minero pagkatapos ng trabaho.
sentences.translation: The miners are tired after work.

sentences.translation: A woman has two ovaries.

sentences.text: Ipinaliwanag ng guro kung ano ang obaryo.
sentences.translation: The teacher explained what the ovary is.

sentences.text: Nagbigay sila ng pagpupugay sa guro.
sentences.translation: They paid tribute to the teacher.

sentences.text: Ito ay pagpupugay para sa ating mga nars.
sentences.translation: This is a salute to our nurses.

sentences.text: Tinutugis po kami.
sentences.translation: We're being pursued.

sentences.text: Naglagay ako ng nilagang itlog at kaunting patis sa aking sopas.
sentences.translation: I put a boiled egg and a little fish sauce in my soup.

sentences.text: Lagyan mo ng patis ang sabaw.
sentences.translation: Put some fish sauce in the soup.

sentences.text: Pumunta kami sa perya kagabi.
sentences.translation: We went to the carnival last night.

sentences.text: Anong laro ang gusto mo sa perya?
sentences.translation: Which game do you like at the fair?

sentences.text: Ako ang representante ng klase namin.
sentences.translation: I am our class representative.

sentences.text: Sino ang representante ng kompanya?
sentences.translation: Who is the company's representative?

cards.gloss: one who blindly follows orders; yes-man

sentences.text: Ayokong maging sunuran ng amo ko.
sentences.translation: I don't want to be my boss's yes-man.

sentences.text: Sunuran lang siya ng kaibigan niya.
sentences.translation: He just does whatever his friend tells him.

sentences.text: Maganda ang tanawin mula sa talampas.
sentences.translation: The view from the plateau is beautiful.

sentences.text: Huwag kayong lumapit sa gilid ng talampas.
sentences.translation: Don't go near the edge of the cliff.

sentences.text: Sakto ang tiyempo ng pagdating mo.
sentences.translation: Your arrival was perfectly timed.

sentences.text: Hintayin natin ang tamang tiyempo para magsabi.
sentences.translation: Let's wait for the right moment to tell them.

sentences.translation: We slept in a tent.

sentences.text: Nagtayo kami ng tolda sa tabi ng ilog.
sentences.translation: We set up a tent beside the river.

sentences.translation: The soil is dried up because there is no rain.

sentences.text: Bakit tuyot na ang mga dahon?
sentences.translation: Why are the leaves already withered?

sentences.translation: The whole country was covered with snow.

sentences.text: Tingnan mo ang bundok na iyon na natatakpan ng niyebe.
sentences.translation: Look at that mountain which is covered with snow.

sentences.translation: Where is your dad?

sentences.translation: My dad is cooking adobo.

sentences.translation: The fish smells fishy.

sentences.text: Malansa ang kamay ko pagkatapos maglinis ng isda.
sentences.translation: My hands smell fishy after cleaning fish.

sentences.translation: A dragonfly landed on the plant.

sentences.text: Nakakita ka na ba ng tutubi?
sentences.translation: Have you ever seen a dragonfly?

sentences.text: Binisita namin ang puntod ng aming ina.
sentences.translation: We visited our mother's grave.

sentences.text: Isang inahin ay nangitlog sa loob ng aking aparador.
sentences.translation: A hen laid an egg in my closet.

sentences.translation: The child wailed when his toy got lost.

sentences.translation: Why is she sobbing loudly outside?

sentences.text: Baduy ang damit na iyan.
sentences.translation: That outfit is tacky.

sentences.text: Baduy ba ang suot ko?
sentences.translation: Is what I'm wearing uncool?

sentences.translation: I want to visit Ireland.

sentences.text: Malamig ba ang panahon sa Irlanda?
sentences.translation: Is the weather cold in Ireland?

sentences.text: Manipis ang lamad sa loob ng itlog.
sentences.translation: The membrane inside an egg is thin.

sentences.text: Gawa sa ano ang lamad na ito?
sentences.translation: What is this membrane made of?

sentences.translation: The mechanic fixed our car.

sentences.text: Magkano ang singil ng mekaniko?
sentences.translation: How much does the mechanic charge?

sentences.text: Pakiabot ang pandikit at gunting na nasa loob ng kahong iyan.
sentences.translation: Hand me the glue and the scissors in that box, please.

sentences.text: Pinag-aralan namin ang pasismo sa klase ng kasaysayan.
sentences.translation: We studied fascism in history class.

sentences.text: Ipinaliwanag ng aklat kung ano ang pasismo.
sentences.translation: The book explained what fascism is.

sentences.translation: A kilo of tomatoes costs thirty pesos.

sentences.text: Treynta minuto lang ang biyahe.
sentences.translation: The trip is only thirty minutes.

cards.gloss: hooked pole for picking fruit; hooking down fruit with such a pole

sentences.text: Gumamit si Lolo ng sungkit para sa mangga.
sentences.translation: Grandpa used a hooked pole to pick the mangoes.

sentences.text: Pahiram naman ng sungkit para makuha ko ang bayabas.
sentences.translation: Please lend me the fruit-picking pole so I can get the guava.

cards.gloss: to ask a favor of; to request politely

sentences.translation: Please keep your eye on my child.

sentences.text: Pakiusap, huwag pakainin ang mga kalapati.
sentences.translation: Don't feed the pigeons, please.

sentences.translation: I lent my coat to a friend of my brother.

sentences.text: Nagsuot si Tatay ng itim na amerikana sa kasal.
sentences.translation: Dad wore a black suit jacket to the wedding.

cards.gloss: he said; she said; according to him/her

sentences.translation: He said he will come home tomorrow night.

sentences.translation: She said we need to hurry.

sentences.translation: The word erpat is slang.

sentences.text: Balbal ba ang salitang iyon?
sentences.translation: Is that word slang?

sentences.translation: There are many orange fish in the river.

sentences.text: Magtatalop ako ng dalandan para sa 'yo.
sentences.translation: I'll peel an orange for you.

sentences.text: Ayaw kong maging dehado sa usapan namin.
sentences.translation: I don't want to be at a disadvantage in our agreement.

sentences.text: Hanga ako sa determinasyon ninyong huwag sumuko.
sentences.translation: I admire your determination to not give up.

sentences.text: Humanga ako sa determinasyon ni Ana na makatapos ng pag-aaral.
sentences.translation: I admire Ana's determination to finish her studies.

sentences.translation: The child believes there is a goblin in the garden.

sentences.text: Nakakita ka na ba ng totoong duwende?
sentences.translation: Have you ever seen a real goblin?

sentences.translation: Our new store's location is strategic.

sentences.translation: The teacher made a strategic plan for the game.

sentences.text: Lumabas kami kahit na napakaginaw.
sentences.translation: Even though it was very cold, we went out.

sentences.text: Nanginginig ako sa ginaw ngayong umaga.
sentences.translation: I'm shivering from the cold this morning.

sentences.text: Para di magsimula ang pagtatalo, di ako umiimik.
sentences.translation: So as not to start an argument, I don't say anything.

sentences.text: Walang imik si Tatay habang kumakain.
sentences.translation: Dad didn't say a word while eating.

sentences.text: Gusto mo bang pumunta rito para sa interbyu sa darating na linggo?
sentences.translation: Would you like to come in for an interview next week?

sentences.text: May interbiyu ako bukas ng umaga para sa bagong trabaho.
sentences.translation: I have an interview tomorrow morning for a new job.

sentences.translation: Make the slices of bread a little thicker.

sentences.text: Kinapalan ng pintor ang pintura sa pader.
sentences.translation: The painter made the paint on the wall thicker.

cards.gloss: to take along as a passenger; to load onto a vehicle

sentences.text: Nakasakay na ako.
sentences.translation: I'm on board.

sentences.text: Pwede mo ba akong isakay?
sentences.translation: Can you give me a ride?

sentences.translation: The boy reached out for another piece of cake.

sentences.translation: My country is far away from Japan.

sentences.text: Nakakain ka na ba ng pagkaing Hapon?
sentences.translation: Have you ever eaten Japanese food?

sentences.translation: The band plays according to the conductor's beat.

sentences.text: Gumamit ang guro ng kumpas ng kamay para ipaliwanag ang aralin.
sentences.translation: The teacher used hand gestures to explain the lesson.

sentences.text: Naging palaka ang prinsipe dahil sa mahiya.
sentences.translation: The prince was turned by magic into a frog.

sentences.text: Nahihiya siya sa kanyang pagayon-gayon.
sentences.translation: He is ashamed of being idle.

sentences.text: Mabait ang aming mga kustomer sa tindahan.
sentences.translation: Our customers at the store are kind.

sentences.text: Nasaan ang kustomer na nag-order ng kape?
sentences.translation: Where is the customer who ordered the coffee?

sentences.text: Naglayag ang mga mangingisda patungo sa laot.
sentences.translation: The fishermen sailed out to the open sea.

sentences.text: Nasa laot na ba ang bangka natin?
sentences.translation: Is our boat already out at sea?

sentences.translation: I have a friend from Lebanon.

sentences.text: Gusto mo bang bumisita sa Libano balang araw?
sentences.translation: Would you like to visit Lebanon someday?

cards.gloss: to be treated; to be cured

sentences.text: Makakagawa ka ba ng mga gamot mula sa laboratoryo?
sentences.translation: Can you produce medicines from the laboratory?

sentences.text: Bumili sila ng gamot.
sentences.translation: They purchased medicine.

cards.gloss: to save; to economize; to cut down expenses

sentences.text: Kailangan nating magtipid ngayong buwan.
sentences.translation: We need to save money this month.

sentences.text: Paano ka nagtitipid sa kuryente?
sentences.translation: How do you cut down on electricity?

sentences.text: Dapat nating isalba ang paligid laban sa polusyon.
sentences.translation: We must rescue the environment from pollution.

sentences.text: Isinalba ng bumbero ang aso mula sa baha.
sentences.translation: The firefighter rescued the dog from the flood.

sentences.text: Mahaba ang manggas ng bago kong damit.
sentences.translation: The sleeves of my new dress are long.

sentences.text: Tupiin mo ang manggas bago ka maghugas ng pinggan.
sentences.translation: Roll up your sleeves before you wash the dishes.

sentences.text: Tumutulong ang paaralan sa mga batang maralita.
sentences.translation: The school helps poor children.

sentences.text: Lumaki siyang maralita pero masipag.
sentences.translation: He grew up poor but hardworking.

sentences.text: Magningas ang apoy kapag hinipan mo.
sentences.translation: The fire will flare up when you blow on it.

sentences.text: Nagpraktis ka ba ng harp nitong umaga?
sentences.translation: Did you practise the harp this morning?

sentences.text: Magpraktis tayo ng sayaw mamayang hapon.
sentences.translation: Let's practice the dance this afternoon.

sentences.text: Nasa segunda ang kotse habang paakyat sa burol.
sentences.translation: The car is in second gear going up the hill.

sentences.text: Basahin mo ang deskripsiyon ng produkto bago bumili.
sentences.translation: Read the product description before buying.

sentences.text: Ano ang deskripsiyon ng nawawala mong bag?
sentences.translation: What is the description of your missing bag?

sentences.text: Mapayapa na ang himlay ni Lolo.
sentences.translation: Grandpa is now at peaceful rest.

sentences.text: Nasa kaliwa ang manibela ng mga kotseng Amerikano.
sentences.translation: Steering wheels of American cars are on the left side.

sentences.text: Humahawak siya ng isang sandok sa kanyang kaliwang kamay.
sentences.translation: She is holding a ladle with her left hand.

cards.gloss: to make the most of; to get one's money's worth (object focus)

sentences.text: Sulitin natin ang bakasyon.
sentences.translation: Let's make the most of the vacation.

sentences.text: Sinulit ko ang bayad ko sa buffet.
sentences.translation: I got my money's worth at the buffet.

sentences.text: Narinig ng nanay ang samo ng anak niya.
sentences.translation: The mother heard her child's plea.

sentences.text: Dininig ng mga tao ang samo ng mga magsasaka para sa ulan.
sentences.translation: The people heard the farmers' plea for rain.

sentences.text: Huwag kang maging malisyoso, magkaibigan lang sila.
sentences.translation: Don't have a dirty mind, they're just friends.

sentences.text: Malisyoso ba ang tanong ng kapitbahay natin?
sentences.translation: Was our neighbor's question malicious?

cards.gloss: family (parents and children); to have children

sentences.text: Marunong magmaneho ang anak kong maliit pa.
sentences.translation: My little son can drive a car.

sentences.text: Ang anak kong babae ay bumibili ng gatas sa tindahan.
sentences.translation: My daughter is buying milk from the store.

cards.gloss: to take responsibility for; to acknowledge as one's own

sentences.text: Natae ako sa salawal ko.
sentences.translation: I soiled myself.

sentences.text: Nakakapag-Ingles ako nang kaunti.
sentences.translation: I can speak English a little.

sentences.text: Nagluto si Nanay ng adobong kangkong.
sentences.translation: Mom cooked adobo water spinach.

sentences.text: Bumili ako ng dalawang tali ng kangkong sa palengke.
sentences.translation: I bought two bundles of water spinach at the market.

sentences.text: May maliit na kulisap sa dahon ng halaman.
sentences.translation: There is a small insect on the plant's leaf.

sentences.text: Takot ka ba sa mga kulisap?
sentences.translation: Are you afraid of insects?

sentences.text: Nasa Hilagang Aprika ang Libya.
sentences.translation: Libya is in North Africa.

sentences.text: Mainit ba ang panahon sa Libya?
sentences.translation: Is the weather hot in Libya?

sentences.text: Dumating ang misyonaryo sa nayon noong nakaraang buwan.
sentences.translation: The missionary arrived in the village last month.

sentences.text: Nagtuturo ang mga misyonaryo ng Bibliya sa mga bata.
sentences.translation: The missionaries teach the Bible to the children.

cards.gloss: ancestor; goblin of folklore living in anthills

sentences.translation: Grandma says there is a goblin in the anthill behind the house.

sentences.text: Malakas ang opensiba ng aming koponan.
sentences.translation: Our team's offense is strong.

sentences.text: Nagsimula ang opensiba ng kalaban sa ikalawang yugto.
sentences.translation: The opponent's attack began in the second phase.

sentences.translation: The teacher broke up the fistfight between the two boys.

sentences.text: Bakit nauwi sa suntukan ang laro?
sentences.translation: Why did the game end in a fistfight?

sentences.text: May ambon pa rin, kaya magdala ka ng payong.
sentences.translation: It's still drizzling, so bring an umbrella.

sentences.text: Naglakad kami sa ambon pauwi.
sentences.translation: We walked home in the drizzle.

sentences.translation: The faucet's valve is already broken.

sentences.text: Isara mo ang balbula ng gas pagkatapos magluto.
sentences.translation: Close the gas valve after cooking.

sentences.text: Siya ay nagbebenta ng gamot sa botika.
sentences.translation: She sells medicine in the pharmacy.

sentences.text: Bumili ako ng gamot sa botika.
sentences.translation: I bought medicine at the pharmacy.

sentences.text: Malaking dagok sa pamilya ang pagkawala ng trabaho ni Tatay.
sentences.translation: Dad losing his job was a big blow to the family.

sentences.text: Nalampasan niya ang bawat dagok ng buhay.
sentences.translation: He overcame every setback in life.

sentences.text: Kumalat ang epidemya sa buong bayan.
sentences.translation: The epidemic spread throughout the town.

sentences.text: Paano natin maiiwasan ang epidemya?
sentences.translation: How can we prevent an epidemic?

sentences.text: Gahaman ang may-ari ng tindahan.
sentences.translation: The store owner is greedy.

sentences.text: Huwag kang maging gahaman sa pagkain.
sentences.translation: Don't be greedy with food.

sentences.text: Maganda ang ilustrasyon sa librong ito.
sentences.translation: The illustrations in this book are beautiful.

sentences.text: Gumawa si Ana ng ilustrasyon para sa kuwento.
sentences.translation: Ana made an illustration for the story.

cards.gloss: a small restaurant selling local food; an eatery

sentences.translation: We ate lunch at the eatery.

sentences.text: May malapit bang karinderya dito?
sentences.translation: Is there a small eatery nearby?

cards.gloss: carriage; float for a saint's image in a procession; hearse

sentences.translation: A horse is pulling the old carriage.

sentences.text: Nakita namin ang karo na puno ng bulaklak sa prusisyon.
sentences.translation: We saw the float full of flowers in the procession.

sentences.translation: I put the books in the cardboard box.

sentences.text: Gawa sa karton ang bahay-bahayan ng bata.
sentences.translation: The child's playhouse is made of cardboard.

sentences.translation: I'm convinced that he is honest.

sentences.text: Hindi pa ba kayo kumbinsido?
sentences.translation: Aren't you convinced yet?

sentences.text: Kumanta si Lola ng kundiman sa party.
